article_content: Without the implementation of nature-based solutions—particularly ending deforestation and restoring native vegetation—Brazil would jeopardize its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) pledges, including achieving net-zero greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by mid-century, according to research published today by an international team led by the University of Oxford. The study concludes that halting deforestation is the single most important mitigation measure Brazil can take to reach net-zero emissions by 2050 while simultaneously preventing biodiversity loss. Titled 'Nature-based Solutions Are Critical for Putting Brazil on Track Towards Net-Zero Emissions by 2050,' the research was published in Global Change Biology. Using an integrated modeling approach, the research team projected Brazil’s GHG emissions through 2050 under various policy scenarios, comparing emissions reductions from nature-based solutions—including large-scale ecological restoration—with engineered alternatives such as bioenergy with carbon capture and storage (BECCS), alongside their relative economic costs. Results indicate that nature-based solutions could deliver nearly 80% of Brazil’s required emissions reductions, averting an average of 781 million tons of carbon dioxide (CO₂) annually over the next three decades. Eliminating both legal and illegal deforestation and scaling up native vegetation restoration could keep Brazil on a clear path to net-zero GHG emissions by approximately 2040—without relying on costly, unproven negative emissions technologies. Lead author Dr. Aline Soterroni (The Agile Initiative, University of Oxford) said: 'Deforestation control and native vegetation restoration are ready to be implemented immediately at relatively low cost compared to engineered solutions like BECCS. This gives Brazil a comparative advantage over other nations. It is also a triple win: effective climate mitigation and adaptation, biodiversity conservation, and economic support.' However, achieving this goal requires national policies that go beyond Brazil’s current Forest Code. The researchers found that implementing the Forest Code alone would close only 38% of the emissions gap by 2050, far short of net-zero targets. Dr. Soterroni added: 'While implementing the Forest Code is urgent and can boost Brazil’s short-term climate ambition, it won’t be sufficient to close the mid-century net-zero gap. The economic investment required to exceed the Forest Code would be at least three times lower than the costs of deploying BECCS—and would significantly reduce the risk of severe climate impacts.' Professor Roberto Schaeffer of the Energy Planning Program at Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro, a co-author, noted: 'Agriculture is Brazil’s second-largest emitting sector and considered hard to abate. While the energy sector already relies heavily on renewables, meeting net-zero ambitions would otherwise depend heavily on BECCS.' 'Nature-based solutions—especially ending deforestation and restoring native vegetation—are the clear path forward,' he added. 'Deploying negative emissions technologies is too expensive and, more critically, too risky, since they haven’t been proven to work at scale yet.' Ahead of COP28, researchers urge that nature-based solutions be fully integrated into national climate pledges, including Brazil’s. Professor Nathalie Seddon, Professor of Biodiversity and Founding Director of the Agile Initiative, stated: 'There is a critical policy gap in Brazil between climate ambition and implementation, driven by the conversion of carbon-rich, biodiverse native ecosystems. Brazil hosts around 20% of the world’s species—so ongoing ecosystem destruction threatens global biosphere integrity. Supporting Brazil in strengthening, enforcing, and going beyond existing laws to eliminate both illegal and legal deforestation is vital.' According to the researchers, Brazil’s net-zero strategy must prioritize: halting deforestation urgently, scaling investments in sustainable agriculture and renewable energy, promoting high-integrity carbon offset projects for residual emissions, and ensuring alignment with a just and equitable transition.

Istraživanje zaključuje da zaustavljanje uništavanja šuma jest najvažnija mjera smanjenja emisija koju Brazil može poduzeti kako bi postigao neto nulte emisije do 2050. godine, istovremeno spriječavajući gubitak biološke raznolikosti. Istraživanje pod naslovom 'Rješenja temeljena na prirodi ključna su za usmjeravanje Brazila na put prema neto nultim emisijama do 2050. godine' objavljeno je u časopisu Global Change Biology. Koristeći integrirani pristup modeliranja, istraživački tim prognozirao je emisije stakleničkih plinova Brazila do 2050. godine u različitim političkim scenarijima, uspoređujući potencijalna smanjenja emisija iz rješenja temeljenih na prirodi – uključujući velikomjernu ekološku obnovu – s inženjerskim alternativama poput biogoriva s hvatanjem i skladištenjem ugljika (BECCS), uz njihove relativne ekonomske troškove. Rezultati pokazuju da bi rješenja temeljena na prirodi mogla osigurati skoro 80% potrebnih smanjenja emisija Brazila, smanjujući prosječno 781 milijun tona ugljičnog dioksida (CO₂) godišnje tijekom sljedećih trideset godina. Uklanjanje i legalnog i ilegalnog uništavanja šuma te promicanje velikomjernih obnova autohtonog biljnog pokrova moglo bi održati Brazilu jasan put prema neto nultim emisijama stakleničkih plinova oko 2040. godine – bez potrebe za korištenjem skupih i još uvijek neprovjerenih tehnologija za negativne emisije. Glavni autor istraživanja, dr. Aline Soterroni (The Agile Initiative, Univerzitet u Oksfordu), rekla je: 'Kontrola uništavanja šuma i obnova autohtonog biljnog pokrova spremni su za odmah primjenu uz relativno niske troškove u usporedbi s inženjerskim rješenjima kao što je BECCS. To Brazilu daje konkurentnu prednost u odnosu na druge zemlje. To je također trostruki dobitak: pažljiva provedba rješenja temeljenih na prirodi pomaže u smanjenju i prilagodbi promjenama klime, zaustavljanju gubitka biološke raznolikosti i podršci gospodarstvu.' Međutim, postizanje ovog cilja zahtijeva nacionalne politike koje idu dalje od trenutnog Šumskog zakona Brazila. Istraživači su utvrdili da bi provedba Šumskog zakona samostalno zatvorila samo 38% emisijskog razmaka do 2050. godine, daleko ispod cilja neto nultih emisija. Dr. Soterroni dodala je: 'Iako je provedba Šumskog zakona hitna i može omogućiti Brazilu da postigne i poveća svoju kratkoročnu klimatsku ambiciju, neće biti dovoljna da zatvori razmak do neto nultih emisija do sredine stoljeća. Ekonomski napori potrebni da se ide dalje od Šumskog zakona bit će barem tri puta manji od troškova povezanih s BECCS-om, a istovremeno smanjuju rizik od štetnih učinaka promjene klime.' Profesor Roberto Schaeffer, profesor programa za energetsko planiranje (PPE) na Univerzitetu Federálnom do Rio de Janeira i suradnik istraživanja, primijetio je: 'Poljoprivreda je drugi najveći emiter u Brazilu i smatra se teško apsorbirajućim sektorom. Energetski sektor Brazila već ima značajan udio obnovljivih izvora, a njegov doprinos cilju neto nultih emisija bio bi jakos ovisan o BECCS-u.' 'Rješenja temeljena na prirodi – posebno prestanak uništavanja šuma i obnova autohtonog biljnog pokrova – su put koji treba pratiti,' dodao je. 'Provjera tehnologija za negativne emisije premnogo je skupa i, što je važnije, preopasna, jer ove tehnologije još nisu dokazane da rade u velikom mjeri.' Prije samita COP28, istraživači pozivaju da se rješenja temeljena na prirodi cjelovito uključe u nacionalne klimatske obveze, uključujući i brazilske. Profesor Nathalie Seddon, profesorica biološke raznolikosti i osnivačica The Agile Initiative, rekla je: 'Postoji politički razmak između trenutne klimatske ambicije i provedbe klimatske politike u Brazilu, uzrokovano pretvaranjem ugljikom bogatih, biološki raznolikih autohtonih ekosustava. Brazil domaći oko 20% svjetskih vrsta – dakle, stalno uništavanje ekosustava prijeti cijeloj biosferi. Stoga je vrlo važno podržati Brazil u naporima da jača, primjenjuje i ide dalje od postojećih zakona kako bi uklonilo i ilegalno i legalno uništavanje šuma.' Prema istraživačima, brazilska strategija neto nultih emisija mora uzeti u obzir hitnost zaustavljanja uništavanja šuma, potrebu za povećanjem ulaganja u održive poljoprivredne prakse i obnovljive izvore energije, važnost promicanja visokokvalitetnih projekata za kompenzaciju ostalih emisija i dosljednost s pravednim i ravnotežnim prijelazom.

article_content: After intense negotiations, union leaders, the White House, and Democratic lawmakers have struck a deal to soften the impact of a controversial tax on expensive employer health plans—often called 'Cadillac plans.' The goal? To keep labor unions on board as Congress pushes forward with major health care reform. Under the revised terms, the tax won’t kick in until a family’s plan exceeds $24,000 in value (up from $23,000) or an individual’s exceeds $8,900 (previously $8,500). Starting in 2014, dental and vision coverage won’t count toward these totals. Union-negotiated plans also get a four-year grace period, delaying the 40% tax until 2018—a concession meant to mirror protections given to other insurers. Annual adjustments to the thresholds will now rise with inflation plus 1%, and special consideration will be given to plans covering many seniors or women. These changes are expected to cut projected tax revenues by about $60 billion over ten years, bringing the total down to roughly $90 billion. In another win for unions, their health plans will be allowed to participate in the new federal health insurance exchanges beginning in 2017. AFL-CIO President Richard Trumka emphasized that the agreement helps not just union workers—about 12% of the workforce—but all working families. Still, critics aren’t convinced. Senate Republican leader Mitch McConnell labeled the deal a 'sweetheart deal,' arguing that most Americans oppose the overall bill. Meanwhile, a recent CNN poll showed stronger public backing for the House’s alternative: a 5.4% income surcharge on earnings above $500,000 for individuals or $1 million for couples—supported by 61% of respondents, compared to just 29% for the Senate’s approach. Though Democratic leaders like Trumka say key figures in Congress backed the compromise, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi noted she hadn’t seen formal documentation yet. Representative Joe Courtney, a vocal critic of the excise tax, called the revised version fairer but cautioned that 'the devil is in the details.' President Obama, while not commenting directly on the deal, challenged Republicans to openly defend the status quo in the upcoming midterm elections. 'If they want to stand with insurance companies instead of families,' he said, 'that’s a fight I’m ready for.' Negotiators aim to finalize the core health care package by week’s end and send it to the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office for scoring. Issues like abortion and immigration, which don’t affect cost estimates, will be settled later.

article_content: Vera Baird, the Police and Crime Commissioner for Northumbria, has chosen not to prioritize low-level drug use in her new policing strategy, arguing that assigning officers to such cases would reduce street presence. While she recognizes drugs as an ongoing issue, her office maintains that most drug seizures occur incidentally during other arrests. This stance, however, conflicts with public feedback: in a recent consultation, 'alcohol and drug-related crimes' ranked as the second-most pressing concern, cited by 20% of respondents. Local leaders like Newcastle City Council’s Nick Forbes are alarmed, fearing this policy overlooks real community suffering, especially in areas where drug use is growing. Even Sir Bernard Hogan-Howe, Metropolitan Police Commissioner, has advocated for stronger enforcement, including routine drug testing for workers to reduce demand. Baird’s deputy, Mark Dennett, defended the decision publicly, stating that formal drug targets could divert officers from neighborhood patrols. Yet Baird herself previously warned that drug crime was increasing — a contradiction now under scrutiny. Phil Butler, her former opponent in the commissioner race, emphasized that drugs are the financial engine behind much of the region’s crime. While the plan does commit to targeting major drug traffickers and organized networks, many believe ignoring smaller-scale dealing undermines trust and fails to tackle the broader crisis.

article_content: A retired gardener has been reunited with a cherished gold ring he lost two decades ago — after his neighbor unearthed it while gardening in her backyard. Allen Wilding, 65, was devastated when he accidentally lost the 18-carat gold pinkie ring, inherited from his father Leslie, shortly after his father’s death in 1993. The ring, a treasured family memento given to him by his mother, had been Leslie’s favorite piece of jewelry. Wilding lost the ring while clearing the garden of a neighbor in the small village of Eardisley, near Hereford. He searched for weeks but eventually gave up, assuming it was gone forever. He later moved away following his divorce. Then, just before Christmas, his friend Claire Morris — who had recently moved into the neighbor’s home — recalled finding the ring eight months earlier while digging a flower bed to plant roses. She had kept it in her jewelry box, never thinking much of it. During a holiday gathering, a casual mention of a metal box on Wilding’s shelf triggered the memory. When he described the ring’s distinctive Griffin engraving, Morris realized it matched what she’d found. She immediately returned it. The ring, untouched for 20 years underground, remains in pristine condition. Wilding expressed profound gratitude: 'I thought I’d lost it forever. To have it back — after all this time — is unbelievable.' Morris, a 52-year-old firefighter, added: 'We almost considered selling it — it’s such a unique piece — but we’re so glad we didn’t. Reuniting it with Allen means far more.'

article_content: A striking portrait of Queen Elizabeth I, painted in the late 16th century by Marcus Gheeraerts the Younger, reveals her in her sixties — wrinkles and all. Unlike most royal images of the era, this painting makes no effort to conceal the signs of aging, offering a rare glimpse of the monarch as she truly appeared. At the time, strict royal protocols governed Elizabeth’s public image. A formal proclamation banned 'unseemly portraits which were to her great offence,' mandating that only images approved by the Queen’s Sergeant Painter could be circulated. Yet this portrait endured, possibly due to its private commission or oversight. Now on display at the Folger Shakespeare Library in Washington, DC, as part of the exhibition 'Nobility and Newcomers in Renaissance Ireland,' the painting has been called unique by co-curator Thomas Herron. He notes that while many artists idealized Elizabeth as eternally youthful, contemporaries often remarked on her natural grace and elegance in later years. The portrait invites comparison with the Duchess of Cambridge’s official portrait, unveiled last month by artist Paul Emsley. Though some critics dismissed it as 'ghastly' and 'lifeless,' the comparison highlights how public expectations around royal representation have evolved — and how rarely we see aging royalty portrayed with such honest realism.

U suprotnosti s većinom kraljevskih slika tog razdoblja, ova slika ne pokušava sakriti znakove starosti, nudeći rijetki pogled na monarha kakva je zapravo izgledala. U to vrijeme, strogi kraljevski protokoli regulirali su javni lik Elizabete. Formalna proklamacija zabranila je 'nepristojne portrete koji su joj bili velika uvreda', tražeći da se samo slike odobrene od strane Kraljevskog slikara mogu distribuirati. Ali ovaj portret je preživio, vjerojatno zbog privatnog naručivanja ili zanemarivanja. Sada je izložen u Folger Shakespeare Library u Washingtonu, DC, kao dio izložbe 'Plemenitstvo i novi dolasci u renesansnoj Irskoj', a portret je nazvan jedinstvenim od strane suradnika-kuratora Tomasa Herrona. On napominje da dok su mnogi umjetnici idealizirali Elizabetu kao vječno mladu, suvremenici su često komentirali njezin prirodni graciozitet i eleganciju u kasnijim godinama. Portret poziva na usporedbu s službenim portretom vojvodice Cambridge, objavljenim prošlog mjeseca od strane umjetnika Paula Emsleyja. Iako su neki kritičari odbacili ga kao 'strašan' i 'bez života', usporedba ističe kako su javna očekivanja o kraljevskoj predstavi evoluirala — i kako rijetko vidimo stariju kraljevsku osobu prikazanu s takvom iskrenom realnošću.

article_content: On a quiet Monday afternoon at a Lloyds Bank branch in Taunton, a would-be robber made a fatal mistake — he walked into a bank filled with people trained to handle chaos. Armed with a 15-inch machete, the 32-year-old man approached the counter, startling customers and staff alike. But instead of fear, he met immediate resistance. Steve Harris, a 32-year-old former rugby player and cage fighter, noticed the weapon out of the corner of his eye. Without hesitation, he shoved his 15-year-old daughter aside and lunged at the attacker, bringing him to the ground. Nearby, Darren Frost, a 6-foot, 17-stone bouncer and Harris’s former coworker, jumped in to help pin the suspect down. The two wrestled him into an armlock while others kept him contained. Amid the commotion, Beverley Higgins, landlady of two local pubs and experienced in managing violent outbursts, stepped forward and pressed the man’s hands flat against the floor until police arrived. Bystander Robert Pink, there to cash a check, admitted he initially thought it was a drill — the response was that fast and coordinated. The suspect, whose attack targeted families and elderly patrons, was swiftly arrested and later charged with attempted robbery and illegal possession of a bladed weapon. He is set to appear in Taunton Crown Court this month. As Frost later reflected, ‘I didn’t even realize it was Steve until I was sitting on him.’ In hindsight, the robber likely regretted choosing that particular Monday lunchtime.

article_content: Washington (CNN) — Years-old videos of MIT economics professor Jonathan Gruber have resurfaced and sparked a political firestorm. In the clips, Gruber — a self-described contributor to the design of Obamacare — remarked that the law passed because 'the American voter' was too unaware of its tax implications to oppose it. With open enrollment for the Affordable Care Act beginning over the weekend and the Supreme Court preparing to review the law again next year, Republicans have used the videos to reinforce claims that the Obama administration misled the public. President Obama dismissed the remarks on Sunday, stating, 'We had a yearlong debate,' and called Gruber 'some adviser who never worked on our staff.' Yet Gruber did serve as a paid consultant to the Obama administration in 2009, receiving nearly $400,000 for his analysis of health reform proposals. He also advised eight states on implementing health insurance exchanges and helped design the Massachusetts health reform under Governor Mitt Romney — the blueprint for Obamacare. Gruber’s most controversial comments came from two 2012–2013 speeches, where he said: 'It's a very clever... exploitation of the lack of economic understanding of the American voter' and that the individual mandate passed because 'the American people are too stupid to understand the difference' between a tax and a penalty. He argued that policymakers intentionally obscured the law’s tax structure to gain public support, knowing voters resist direct taxation even when they benefit from services funded by it. Democrats have tried to downplay Gruber’s influence, with Speaker Nancy Pelosi claiming she didn’t know who he was — despite having publicly cited his work in 2009. Meanwhile, Gruber maintains that the ACA improved access to care and cost less than projected, and that political compromise sometimes requires strategic ambiguity. While Gruber is not the sole architect of Obamacare — the law was drafted by multiple congressional committees and passed by both houses — his economic modeling and policy guidance were instrumental in shaping its core mechanisms: the individual mandate, subsidies, and insurance exchanges. His remarks have reignited debates about transparency in policymaking and whether the ends justify the means.

S obzirom na početak otvorene registracije za Affordable Care Act u vikend i Supreme Court koji će ponovno pregledavati zakon sljedeće godine, republikanci su koristili te snimke kako bi potvrdili tvrdnje da je administracija Obame prevarila javnost. Predsjednik Obama odbio je te komentare u nedjelju, navodeći da je 'imali godinu dana rasprave' i nazvao Grubera 'nekim savjetnikom koji nikada nije radio u našem timu'. Međutim, Gruber je započeo kao plaćeni savjetnik za administraciju Obame 2009. godine, dobivajući gotovo 400.000 dolara za svoju analizu prijedloga zdravstvene reforme. Također je savjetovao osam država u implementaciji zdravstvenih razmjena i pomogao u dizajniranju zdravstvene reforme u Massachusettsu pod guvernerom Mittom Romneym — osnovu za Obamacare. Najkontroverzniji Gruberovi komentari došli su iz dvaju govorâ iz 2012.–2013. godine, gdje je rekao: 'To je vrlo pametna... iskoristba nedostatka ekonomske razumijevanja američkog birača' i da je individualni mandat prošao jer su 'američki građani prenepismeni da razumiju razliku' između poreza i kazne. Tvrdio je da su političari namjerno zamaglili poresku strukturu zakona kako bi stekli javnu podršku, znajući da birači odbijaju direktno plaćanje poreza čak i kada koriste usluge koje su njime financirane. article_content: A five-year-old Jack Russell terrier named Stanley has taken the internet by storm after a series of photos captured him mid-run on Dunnett Beach in Caithness—with all four paws off the ground, giving the illusion he’s soaring through the air. His owner, 59-year-old professional photographer Steve Arkley from Forres, Morayshire, never expected the viral explosion when he posted the candid shots. 'I didn’t even know he moved like that until I saw the pictures,' Arkley said. The images quickly amassed thousands of likes and comments, with viewers comparing Stanley to Bolt, the heroic dog from Disney’s 2008 animated film, and joking that he needs a cape to complete the superhero look. One user, John Bruce Ferguson, famously wrote: 'Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No—it’s a Jack Russell!' Others, like Anne McKenzie Kivari, simply declared, 'That dog’s not running… he’s flying!' Arkley, who describes Stanley as 'very happy,' 'extremely loyal,' and someone who 'loves life,' says the photos perfectly capture his pup’s boundless energy. Beyond beach sprints, Stanley enjoys digging into fox holes and playfully tussling with his Border Terrier sister, Evie. The whole phenomenon was unplanned—Arkley just wanted to document a quiet afternoon. Now, he jokes he’ll have to buy Stanley a bone as a reward for becoming an accidental internet legend.

Njegov vlasnik, 59-godišnji profesionalni fotograf Steve Arkley iz Forresa u Morayshiru, nikad nije očekivao takav viralni uspjeh kad je objavio te slučajne snimke. 'Nisam ni znao da se kreće tako dok nisam video slike,' rekao je Arkley. Slike su brzo privukle tisuće lajkova i komentara, a gledatelji su uspoređivali Stanleya s Bolтом, herojskim psom iz Disneyeve animirane filma iz 2008., i šaljivo tvrdili da mu treba kapa kako bi bio savršen superheroj. Jedan korisnik, John Bruce Ferguson, znamenito je napisao: 'Je li to ptica? Je li to avion? Ne — to je Jack Russell!' Ostali, kao Anne McKenzie Kivari, jednostavno su rekli: 'Ovaj pas ne trči… on lebdi!' Arkley, koji opisuje Stanleya kao 'vrlo sretnog', 'izuzetno vjernog' i nekoga tko 'voli život', kaže da te slike savršeno zahvaćaju njegovu neumornu energiju. Osim trčanja po plažama, Stanley voli kopati u špiljama lisica i igra se s svojom sestrom Border Terijerkom Evie. Cijela pojava bila je nepredviđena — Arkley je samo htio zabilježiti tihi poslijepodne. Sada šali da će morati kupiti Stanleyu kost kao nagradu za postajanje slučajne internet legende.

article_content: By Oliver Pickup. UPDATED: 09:55 EST, 12 September 2011. Following last week’s report that a convoy of dozens of vehicles traveled south from Libya into neighboring Niger, carrying close supporters of Muammar Gaddafi—if not the 69-year-old former dictator himself—it has now been reported that one of his sons, Saadi Gaddafi, has also crossed the border. A government spokesperson for Niger, a large, landlocked West African nation where over 80% of the territory is Sahara Desert, confirmed that 37-year-old Saadi Gaddafi—a former professional footballer in Italy—has entered the country. Saadi, one of the most prominent figures from his father’s regime to flee, reportedly arrived with nine others. If statements from Niger’s Justice Minister Amadou Morou are accurate, his arrival marks a significant development. Saadi Gaddafi, pictured alongside his father in 2005, gained international attention in 2003 after signing with Italian club Perugia. He played only one match before failing a drug test. He previously served on the board of Juventus, whose 7.5% ownership stake is held by a Libyan consortium. He was also captain of the Libyan national football team, president of the Libyan Football Federation, and captain of his hometown club in Tripoli. According to officials, Saadi’s convoy is heading south toward Agadez, where other fleeing Libyan loyalists are believed to be sheltering in a hotel. 'I wish to announce that one of Gaddafi’s sons—Saadi Gaddafi—was intercepted in northern Niger by a Nigerien military patrol,' said Justice Minister Amadou Morou, referring to the former Serie A player and businessman. He added that Saadi 'has no legal status whatsoever' in Niger, meaning he has not been granted refugee protection or associated rights. The group is currently believed to be staying at a hotel in Agadez, with speculation they may move on to Burkina Faso. In Tripoli, rebel forces reportedly captured Abu Zayd Dourd, Libya’s former prime minister and head of external intelligence. Since last week, multiple convoys carrying senior regime officials, soldiers, and civilians have crossed Niger’s porous desert border. Among those fleeing were several of Gaddafi’s top military commanders, including his chief of security and head of the southern command. Niger has come under growing international scrutiny for permitting former regime members to enter its territory. Saadi’s arrival is expected to intensify demands for cooperation with Libya’s interim government, which seeks the arrest and trial of all Gaddafi sons—and Gaddafi himself, who remains at large. Last week, the United States urged Niger to detain anyone potentially subject to prosecution in Libya, seize their weapons, and impound illegally exported state assets—including money and jewels. While some senior officials have escaped, Libya’s new leadership has arrested numerous former high-ranking regime figures since rebel forces seized Tripoli on August 21, effectively ending Gaddafi’s nearly 42-year rule. Yesterday, Anes Sharif, spokesman for Tripoli’s Military Council, confirmed the capture of Abu Zayd Dourd, a longtime Gaddafi insider who also served as prime minister in the 1990s. As Libya’s new authorities consolidate control in Tripoli, Gaddafi loyalists continue to resist in three strongholds: Sirte on the Mediterranean coast, Sabha in the southern desert, and Bani Walid southeast of the capital. According to Al Jazeera, a pro-Gaddafi radio station in Bani Walid is urging residents to rise up against the revolutionaries, promising 'the prettiest girls in town' as a reward.

article_content: The last few years haven't been kind to the private jet industry. A still-recovering global economy has led to continued sluggish sales, and many executives are wary of facing shareholder backlash for using corporate jets. However, the market is beginning to stabilize, thanks to innovations from a handful of forward-thinking companies working to make private aviation faster, cheaper, and more accessible. According to WINGX Advance, a market intelligence provider for the aviation industry, the private jet sector—including fractional and whole ownership—was virtually stagnant in the U.S. last year and declined by nearly 4% in Europe. In contrast, the charter market is booming. Adam Twidell, founder of PrivateFly—an online booking platform often compared to Expedia or Priceline for commercial flights—has seen his company grow threefold annually since launching in 2007. While third-party booking is standard in commercial aviation, PrivateFly pioneered it in private jets. 'When I looked online, I couldn’t believe there was no way to book a private jet,' Twidell says. He and his wife, Carol Cork, sold her house to fund the venture. 'My mother-in-law still isn’t fully convinced it was a smart move,' Twidell jokes. Today, PrivateFly is Europe’s fastest-growing aviation company. Customers can compare prices for over 2,500 aircraft via the website or mobile app and book flights with near-instant availability. 'Our record time from request to takeoff is 40 minutes,' he notes. For the 700 operators listed on the platform, the service helps prevent aircraft from sitting idle and accruing parking fees. 'It’s essentially a matchmaking system,' Twidell explains. By making supply and demand more transparent, prices have dropped. For example, operators can discount 'empty legs'—return flights without passengers—making private travel more affordable. JetSuite, a U.S.-based charter company, also leverages empty legs through daily 'SuiteDeals' posted on Facebook and Twitter. Prices range from $499 to $1,499 per aircraft—not per person—for flights on a Phenom 100 (up to four seats) or CJ3 (up to six). 'Some trips are short, like Santa Monica to Van Nuys,' says CEO Alex Wilcox. 'But sometimes you can get a full plane from Los Angeles to New York for $499, and split it among four people.' He adds, 'That’s rare.' JetSuite requires a $50,000 membership, but clients receive significantly more value: flight hours are deducted from a balance, and the company charges roughly half the industry rate—around $3,000 per hour. 'Many competitors are stuck in the 1980s, thinking private jets mean champagne and caviar. We’re a time machine,' says Wilcox, a founding partner of JetBlue. JetSuite cuts costs by offering transparent booking options, such as choosing airports with lower landing fees, and using lighter, fuel-efficient aircraft. 'The Phenom 100 is cheaper to buy and burns less fuel. We save on fuel and capital—and pass those savings along,' Wilcox says. Though the model may seem austere for a luxury product, Wilcox argues it aligns with today’s climate: 'There’s stigma around corporations owning jets. Many companies need alternatives—especially for executives afraid their shareholders will disapprove.' JumpJet, a new entrant launched in October 2023, aims to bring private jet prices closer to first- and business-class commercial fares. Still gathering members, it plans to begin flights in May. Like JetSuite, it operates on a membership model ($2,350/month for 10 domestic round-trip flights under 3.5 hours), but owns no aircraft. Instead, it brokers charters and groups members traveling to the same destination. 'We’re not one jet, one customer—that’s the old model,' says CEO Will Ashcroft. 'We match people going the same way.' While not every JumpJet flight equals first class, long-haul trips can be competitively priced. For example, a coast-to-coast flight costs $6,600 with JumpJet versus $6,000 on a commercial airline. 'But you save three to five hours daily by skipping security, baggage claim, and customs,' Ashcroft says. 'When you factor in time, I’d take the private jet every time.'
translated_content: Posljednje godine nisu bile dobre za industriju privatnih aviona. Još uvijek oporavljajuća globalna ekonomija dovela je do kontinuirane spore prodaje, a mnogi izvršni direktori su oprezni da ne izazovu reakciju dionika zbog korištenja korporativnih aviona. Međutim, tržište počinje da se stabilizira, zahvaljujući inovacijama nekoliko naprednih tvrtki koje rade kako bi učinile privatnu aviaciju bržom, jeftinijom i pristupačnijom. Prema WINGX Advance, pružatelju tržišne inteligencije za avijacijsku industriju, sektor privatnih aviona — uključujući fractional i potpuno vlasništvo — bio je gotovo stagniran u SAD-u prošle godine i smanjio se za skoro 4% u Europi. Nasuprot tome, tržište zakupa raste. Adam Twidell, osnivač PrivateFly-a — online platforme za rezervaciju često uspoređivane s Expedia ili Priceline za komercijalne letove — video je da se njegova tvrtka godišnje povećala tri puta od osnivanja 2007. Iako je treća strana za rezervacije standardna u komercijalnoj avijaciji, PrivateFly je pokrenuo tu praksu u privatnoj avijaciji. 'Kada sam pogledao online, nije mi bilo vjerojatno da ne postoji način da se rezervira privatni avion,' kaže Twidell. On i njegova žena, Carol Cork, prodali su njen dom kako bi financirali poduzetništvo. 'Moj testa još uvijek nije potpuno uvjerena da je to pametna odluka,' šali se Twidell. Danas je PrivateFly najbrže rastuća avijacijska tvrtka u Europi. Korisnici mogu uspoređivati cijene preko 2.500 zrakoplova putem web-stranice ili mobilne aplikacije i rezervirati letove s gotovo trenutačnom dostupnošću. 'Naš rekordno vrijeme od zahtjeva do polijetanja je 40 minuta,' kaže on. Za 700 operatera koji su navedeni na platformi, usluga pomaže da se spriječe zrakoplovi da stoje neiskorišteni i nakupljaju troškove parkiranja. 'To je u biti sistem za susretavanje ponude i tražnje,' objašnjava Twidell. Time što su ponuda i tražnja postale transparentnije, cijene su se smanjile. Na primjer, operateri mogu nuditi popuste na 'praznim nogama' — povratnim letovima bez putnika — što čini privatno putovanje jeftinijim. JetSuite, američka tvrtka za zakup, također iskorištava prazne noge kroz dnevne 'SuiteDeals' objavljene na Facebooku i Twitteru. Cijene variraju od 499 do 1.499 dolara po zrakoplovu — ne po osobi — za letove na Phenom 100 (do četiri sjedala) ili CJ3 (do šest sjedala). 'Neke od tih vožnji su kratke, kao iz Santa Monice u Van Nuys,' kaže izvršni direktor Alex Wilcox. 'Ali ponekad možete dobiti cijeli avion iz Los Angelesa u New York za 499 dolara i podijeliti cijenu između četiri osobe.' Dodaje: 'To je rijetkost.' JetSuite zahtijeva članstvo od 50.000 dolara, ali klijenti dobivaju značajno veću vrijednost: satovi leta oduzimaju se iz balansa, a tvrtka naplaćuje otprilike polovicu industrijske tarife — oko 3.000 dolara po satu. 'Mnogi konkurenti su zarobljeni u 1980-ima, kada su privatni avioni značili šampanjac i kaviar. Mi smo stroj za vrijeme,' kaže Wilcox, osnivački partner JetBlue-a. JetSuite uštede novac nudenjem transparentnijih opcija rezervacije, kao što su odabir zračnih luka s nižim taksa za slijetanje, te korištenjem lakših, manje skupih zrakoplova. 'Phenom 100 je jeftiniji za kupiti i potroši manje goriva. Uštedimo na gorivu i kapitalu — i prenosimo te uštede na korisnike,' kaže Wilcox. Iako se ovaj model može činiti surovim za luksuzni proizvod, Wilcox tvrdi da odgovara današnjem klimatu: 'Postoji stigama oko korporacija koje imaju vlastite avione. Mnoge tvrtke traže alternative — posebno za direktore koji se boje da će ih dionici osuditi.' JumpJet, nova tvrtka koja je započela u listopadu 2023., cilja smanjiti cijene privatnih aviona na razinu komercijalnih karata za prvu i poslovnu klasu. Još uvijek prikuplja članove i planira započeti letove u svibnju. Poput JetSuitea, radi na modelu članstva (2.350 dolara mjesečno za 10 unutarnjih krugova do 3,5 sata), ali ne posjeduje nikakve avione. Umjesto toga, ona aranžira zakup i grupira članove koji putuju istim smjerom. 'Nismo jedan avion, jedan korisnik — to je stari model,' kaže izvršni direktor Will Ashcroft. 'Mi povezujemo ljude koji idu istim smjerom.' Iako ne svaki JumpJet let odgovara prvoj klasi, dugi letovi mogu biti konkurentno cijenjeni. Na primjer, let s obale na obalu košta 6.600 dolara s JumpJetom protiv 6.000 dolara s komercijalnom avio-kompanijom. 'Ali uštedite tri do pet sati dnevno preskačući sigurnosne provjere, prtljag i carinu,' kaže Ashcroft. 'Kada uzmete u obzir vrijeme, ja bih svaki dan odabrao privatni avion.'

article_content: In a terrifying incident captured on camera, cameraman Noel Greaves-Lord was struck by an out-of-control Ducati superbike while filming near a bend in a road in Cannes, France. The impact shattered his right ankle and left him with a severe open fracture. The 52-year-old, a freelance filmmaker who had worked for the BBC, Sky, and ITV, was in Cannes on a personal favor to a friend when the accident occurred. Despite immediate medical intervention, he later developed an untreatable MRSA infection, which led doctors to amputate his leg to save his life. Greaves-Lord endured more than a year of surgeries and rehabilitation before the amputation became necessary. He has since been forced to give up his career and now relies on a prosthetic limb. After a four-year legal battle, he was awarded a substantial, undisclosed compensation settlement by the motorcyclist’s insurers through the High Court in London. His lawyer, Demetrius Danas of Irwin Mitchell, stated the payout reflects Greaves-Lord’s complex long-term needs and the profound impact the injury has had on his life. Reflecting on the event, Greaves-Lord said: 'The bike just slipped out — it happened very, very quickly. There was nothing I could do.' He credits his quick reflexes — extending his leg to shield himself — with preventing even greater harm. 'It could’ve killed me,' he said. 'I was conscious the whole time. Those eight minutes waiting for the ambulance felt like a lifetime.' Though deeply affected by the loss of mobility and independence, Greaves-Lord expressed relief that the legal process has concluded. 'I can now focus on rebuilding my life and continuing my recovery,' he said. 'The last four years have been devastating — but I’m determined to move forward.'

Udarac je razbio njegov desni gležanj i ostavio ga s teškom otvorenom frakturom. 52-godišnjak, slobodni filmski radnik koji je radio za BBC, Sky i ITV, bio je u Kani na osobnoj usluzi prijatelju kada se dogodila nesreća. Iako je odmah primio medicinsku pomoć, kasnije je razvio neizlječivu MRSA infekciju, koja je liječnike navela da amputiraju njegovu nogu kako bi spasili život. Greaves-Lord je prošao više od godinu dana operacija i rehabilitacije prije nego što je amputacija postala nužna. Od tada je bio prisiljen napustiti svoj posao i sada ovisi o protezi. Nakon četverogodišnjeg pravnog sukoba, dobio je značajnu, neobjavljenu naknadu od osigurača motocikliste putem Višeg suda u Londonu. Njegov odvjetnik, Demetrius Danas iz Irwin Mitchell, rekao je da ta naknada odražava kompleksne dugoročne potrebe Greaves-Lorda i dubok utjecaj povrede na njegov život. Reflektirajući na događaj, Greaves-Lord je rekao: 'Motocikl je samo iskliznuo — dogodilo se vrlo, vrlo brzo. Ništa nisam mogao učiniti.' Zasluguje svoju brzu reakciju — istegnuo je nogu da se zaštići — za sprečavanje još veće štete. 'Moglo je ubiti me,' rekao je. 'Bio sam svjestan cijelo vrijeme. Te osam minuta čekanja na ambulantu bile su najduže osam minuta u mom životu.' Iako duboko pogođen gubitkom pokretljivosti i neovisnosti, Greaves-Lord izrazio je olakšanje jer je pravni proces završen. 'Sada se mogu potpuno usredotočiti na obnovu svog života i nastaviti sa oporavkom,' rekao je. 'Posljednje četiri godine bile su uništavajuće — ali odlučan sam ići dalje.'

article_content: Mercedes has unveiled the G63 AMG 6x6 — a limited-edition, six-wheel off-road vehicle, marking its first such model since the G4 produced for Nazi Germany in the 1930s. Based on the iconic G-Wagon, the G63 AMG 6x6 combines tank-like off-road capability, sports-car acceleration, and limousine-level luxury. Mercedes replaced the standard G-Wagon’s 3.0-liter diesel engine with a twin-turbocharged 5.5-liter V8, delivering 536 horsepower (536 bhp) and enabling 0–62 mph in under six seconds — despite its 19-foot length and 3.85-ton weight. Equipped with 37-inch wheels, Mercedes claims the vehicle navigates rocky terrain with 'the agility of a mountain goat' and fords rivers with 'almost child’s play' ease. On-road performance is described as 'catapult-like,' impressing even skeptics of such a massive pickup. Priced at £350,000, it is the most expensive Mercedes ever produced — triple the cost of a standard G-Wagon. Annual production is capped at approximately 30 units, with anticipated demand strongest in the Middle East. This is not Mercedes’ first six-wheel off-roader. Between 1934 and 1939, the company produced the G4 for the German military. Adolf Hitler owned eight of them, and they were considered prestige vehicles by high-ranking officials. Unlike the modern G63 AMG 6x6, the G4 was not a true six-wheel drive — power was delivered only to the rear four wheels. Only three authentic G4s remain today; others are reconstructions. One original was gifted by Hitler to General Franco in 1939 and is now owned by the Spanish royal family.

Zasnovan na ikoničnom G-Wagonu, G63 AMG 6x6 kombinira off-road sposobnosti poput tenka, akceleraciju kao sportni automobil i luksuzan osjećaj poput limuzine. article_content: Last month, an anonymous donor left a seemingly ordinary landscape painting at a Housing Works thrift shop on 23rd Street in New York City. The shop, which supports homeless individuals and people living with HIV/AIDS, sold the piece to a customer who later returned it — now dramatically altered. Someone had painted a Nazi officer seated calmly on a bench beside the serene mountain lake. Months later, when staff realized the artwork bore Banksy’s unmistakable style, they confirmed its origin after he publicly claimed it on Instagram during his October 2013 New York residency. He titled it 'The Banality of the Banality of Evil' and signed it beneath the original artist’s name, K. Sager. The thrift shop decided to auction the piece to maximize its impact. Starting bids were set at $74,000, but the final sale soared to $615,000 — the most money ever raised by a single item across all 12 Housing Works locations. Auction winner gorpetri remains unidentified. Housing Works expressed heartfelt thanks on Twitter, writing: '$615,000! On behalf of our clients, staff & others living with HIV/AIDS, thank you, thank you, thank you #banksyny.' Rebecca Edmondson, their PR director, told Gothamist this marked a historic milestone for the organization. Though the donation was made secretly, the shop never knew who dropped it off — only that it would help save lives.

article_content: Amid the chaos of displacement and survival, a quiet revolution is unfolding on a dusty baseball diamond just outside Atlanta. At the Global Village School, a small nonprofit serving refugee teenage girls, laughter echoes across the field as girls from Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Burundi, and Myanmar kick soccer balls — some in donated sneakers, others barefoot — chasing not just the ball, but a future. For 16-year-old Robika, an Afghan refugee who once lived in Russia, shouting 'Kick it clear to Russia!' isn’t just a joke — it’s a memory. Three years ago, she landed in Clarkston, Georgia, with her mother and two brothers after fleeing conflict. Today, she’s learning English, dreaming of journalism, and finding belonging on the field. Clarkston, a town of fewer than 8,000 people, has become one of America’s most diverse microcosms. Since the 1990s, federal housing policies redirected refugees here, drawn by low rents and accessible buses. Now, over 6,000 people from more than 15 conflict-affected nations call it home. While public schools struggled to meet the needs of girls arriving with zero English, the Global Village School stepped in — founded by educators who saw that without targeted support, these girls would vanish into the system. Led by academic director Kelley Provence and a handful of dedicated staff, the school operates on $250,000 a year — all from donations and volunteers. Girls are assessed individually, placed in learning tiers, and given time to grow. Some graduate to high school; others earn GEDs and aim for college. For Robika, the daily 90-minute bus ride is worth it. 'When I came here,' she says, 'I understood nothing. Now, they treat me like I matter.' Behind every smile is a story of loss. Melody and Rita, sisters from Myanmar, speak softly of their parents, still overseas. 'My mom cries when we talk,' Melody shares, 'but she won’t tell us why — she doesn’t want us to be sad.' They don’t dwell. In their cultures, silence isn’t suppression — it’s protection. And in this classroom, silence is honored. Robika wants to report the truth. Melody dreams of beauty salons. Rita wants to be a scientist. Their ambitions aren’t grand because they’re lucky — they’re grand because they’ve earned every step.
translated_content: U srednjem kaosu istjecanja i preživljavanja, tiha revolucija se odvija na prašnjavom bejzbol terenu van Atlante. Na Globalnoj seljskoj školi, maloj nezapravnici koja služi djevojkama-izbjeglicama, smijeh se raznosi po igralištu dok djevojke iz Afganistana, Etiopije, Burundija i Mjanmara udaraju nogometne lopte — neke u darovanim patikama, druge bosone — gonjeći ne samo loptu, već i budućnost. Za 16-godišnju Robiku, afganistansku izbjeglicu koja je jednom živjela u Rusiji, vričanje 'Udari je jasno do Rusije!' nije samo šala — to je sjećanje. Tri godine nazad, došla je u Clarkston, Georgiju, sa svojom majkom i dva brata nakon bijega od sukoba. Danas uči engleski, sanja o novinarstvu i nalazi pripadnost na terenu. Clarkston, grad od manje od 8.000 stanovnika, postao je jedna od najraznovrsnijih mikrokosmičnih zajednica u Americi. Od 1990-ih, federalne politike stanovanja preusmjerile su izbjeglice ovamo, privučene niskim cijenama i pristupačnim autobusima. Sada više od 6.000 ljudi iz više od 15 konfliktno zahvaćenih zemalja zove ovo domom. Dok su javne škole borile da zadovolje potrebe djevojaka koje su stigle bez ikakve znanja engleskog, Globalna seljska škola je ušla u prazninu — osnovana od strane obrazovnih radnika koji su vidjeli da bez ciljanog podrške te djevojke bi nestale u sustavu. Pod vodstvom akademskog direktora Kelij Provence i malog broja posvećenih zaposlenika, škola radi s godišnjim proračunom od 250.000 dolara — sve iz donacija i volontera. Djevojke se individualno procjenjuju, raspoređuju u razine učenja i dobivaju vrijeme da rastu. Nekome se uspije preći u srednju školu; drugi stječu GED i prijavljuju se na fakultet. Za Robiku, dnevni 90-minutni put autobusom vrijedi. 'Kada sam došla ovdje,' kaže ona, 'nisam ništa razumjela. Sada me tretiraju kao da važim.' Iza svakog osmjeha leži priča o gubitku. Melody i Rita, sestre iz Mjanmara, tiho pričaju o svojim roditeljima koji su još uvijek u zemlji porijekla. 'Mama plače kad razgovaramo,' kaže Melody, 'ali neće nam reći zašto — ne želi da budemo tužni.' One se ne zadržavaju. U njihovim kulturama, tišina nije potiskivanje — to je zaštita. I u ovoj učionici, tišina se poštuje. Robika želi prijavljivati istinu. Melody sanja o salonima za ljepotu. Rita želi biti znanstvenica. Njihovi snovi nisu veliki jer su sretni — oni su veliki jer su zaslužili svaki korak.

article_content: Lyon, France — Former All Blacks centre George Moala will finally make his long-awaited debut for Tonga at the Rugby World Cup, lining up against Romania in Lille on Sunday. The Pacific islanders are aiming for their first victory of the tournament. Moala, who earned four caps for New Zealand between 2015 and 2017, was cleared to play despite serving a three-match ban for a dangerous tip tackle against Canada in early August. He replaces fellow former All Black Malakai Fekitoa at outside centre as part of six changes to the side that lost to South Africa last week. 'We should win this game,' said head coach Toutai Kefu. 'It won’t be easy, but if we bring the same energy, aggression, and commitment we’ve shown in recent matches, we’ll get a good result.' Sonatane Takulua, Tonga’s most-capped player, returns as captain at scrumhalf, replacing fellow ex-All Black Augustine Pulu. Charles Piutau continues at fullback for his fourth consecutive pool match, while fifth former All Black, number eight Vaea Fifita, remains sidelined due to a four-match ban following a high tackle against Scotland. Adam Coleman, who represented Australia at the previous World Cup, joins Leva Fifita — Vaea’s brother — in the second row. Wings Afusipa Taumoepeau and Solomone Kata return after being left out against the Springboks. Kefu also reshuffled the back row: Semisi Paea moves to blindside flanker, and Sione Vailanu is promoted from the bench to start at number eight. 'We wanted to give every player a chance,' Kefu explained. 'Even if this match didn’t affect our chances of advancing, we’d still have made these changes. If we can rotate without hurting our chances to win, why not?' Tonga’s starting XV: 1. Siegfried Fisi'ihoi, 2. Paula Ngauamo, 3. Ben Tameifuna, 4. Leva Fifita, 5. Adam Coleman, 6. Semisi Paea, 7. article_content: In the rugged deserts near Douglas, Arizona, something extraordinary has been quietly returning: the jaguar. Once considered a ghost of the American Southwest, this elusive big cat has reappeared — not as a captive exhibit, but as a wild traveler crossing from Mexico. In 1996, rancher Warner Glenn, a lifelong hunter of mountain lions, was stunned when his dogs cornered a jaguar on a rocky ridge. He snapped what’s now recognized as the first photograph of a living jaguar in the United States in modern times. He didn’t know it then, but it was just the beginning. Over the next decade, others followed suit. Jack Childs captured the first video footage later that same year. Together with biologist Emil McCain, Childs launched the Borderlands Jaguar Detection Project, deploying over 50 motion-triggered cameras along the border. Since 2001, they’ve documented 69 images of just three distinct jaguars — one of them, nicknamed Macho B, easily identified by a spot on his flank that looks uncannily like Pinocchio’s nose. These cats aren’t residents — scientists believe fewer than 120 remain in the wild in northern Mexico, and the individuals seen in Arizona are transient visitors. Yet their presence raises urgent questions. The U.S.-Mexico border wall, now stretching 470 miles thanks to a DHS waiver of 30 environmental laws, risks cutting off their natural movement. Macho B’s tracks have been found weaving through gaps in the fence — proof he crosses freely, but also that the barrier is increasingly obstructing his path. Conservationists argue the wall isn’t stopping people — drug smugglers and traffickers simply use wire cutters or torches — but it’s crippling wildlife. The fence has also pushed illegal activity into fragile mountain habitats, where cameras are being destroyed faster than they’re installed. Meanwhile, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, tasked with protecting species like the jaguar, finds itself caught between two federal mandates: safeguard nature and enable border enforcement. Some progress is being made. Border Patrol has begun placing surveillance towers away from key wildlife corridors and designing barriers that allow larger animals to pass. Still, the rush to complete the wall under political pressure leaves many uneasy. 'National security and environmental protection don’t have to be enemies,' says Matt Clark of Defenders of Wildlife. 'We just need time to do it right.' For Glenn, who now writes books about his encounters and wishes President Bush would ride a mule alongside him to witness the wildness firsthand, the jaguar isn’t just an animal — it’s a symbol. 'It’s a magnificent creature,' he says. 'My granddaughter might never see one if we keep building walls. I’d gladly give up a few calves to help it survive.' Biologist McCain echoes him: 'The jaguar belongs here. It’s as American as the bald eagle — and just as precious.'
translated_content: U ruggednim pustinjskim područjima blizu Douglasa, Arizona, nešto izvanredno tiho se vraća: jaguar. Jednom smatrano duhom američkog jugozapada, ova tajanstvena velika mačka ponovno se pojavila — ne kao zatvoreni primjerak, već kao divlji putnik koji prelazi iz Meksika. Godine 1996. vlasnik stoke Warner Glenn, strastveni lovac na planinske lavove, bio je iznenađen kada su njegovi psi gonili jaguara na stijenu. Snimio je prvu fotografiju živog jaguara u SAD-u u moderno doba. Tada nije znao, ali to je bilo samo početak. Tokom sljedeće decenije, drugi su slijedili. Jack Childs snimio je prvi video kasnije te iste godine. Zajedno s biologom Emilom McCainom, Childs je osnovao Borderlands Jaguar Detection Project, postavljajući preko 50 kamera sa pokretom uz granicu. Od 2001. godine dokumentirali su 69 slika samo tri različita jaguara — jedan od njih, nadimak Macho B, lako prepoznatljiv po mrlji na boku koja izgleda kao da je slična Pinocchiju. Ove mačke nisu stanovnici — znanstvenici vjeruju da ih manje od 120 ostaje u divljini sjevernog Meksika, a pojedinci koji se vide u Arizoni su prolazni posjetitelji. Ipak, njihovo prisustvo podiže hitna pitanja. Zid na američko-meksičkoj granici, koji sada proteže se 470 milja zbog odricanja DHS-a od 30 zakona o okolišu, rizikuje ometanje njihovog prirodnog kretanja. Tragovi Macho B-a pronađeni su kako se penju kroz praznine u zidu — dokaz da slobodno prelazi, ali i da je prepreka sve više ometa njegov put. Zaštitnici prirode tvrde da zid ne zaustavlja ljude — trgovci drogom i ljudima jednostavno koriste rezalice ili gorionike — ali uništava divlje životinje. Zid je također potisnuo ilegalnu aktivnost u ranjiva planinska područja, gdje su kamere uništavane brže nego što ih možemo postaviti. Međutim, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, zadužen za zaštitu vrsta poput jaguara, nalazi se između dviju savezne obveze: zaštititi prirodu i omogućiti granicu. Neke napredke se čine. Border Patrol je počeo postavljati tornjeve za nadzor daleko od ključnih staza divljih životinja i dizajnirati prepreke koje dopuštaju većim životinjama da prolaze. Ipak, naglašeni pritisak da se zid dovrši pod političkom brzinom ostavlja mnoge neugodno. 'Nacionalna sigurnost i zaštita okoliša ne moraju biti neprijatelji,' kaže Matt Clark iz Defenders of Wildlife. 'Potrebno nam je vrijeme da to učinimo ispravno.' Za Glenna, koji danas piše knjige o svojim susretima i želi da predsjednik Bush dođe na magarcu da vidi što se događa u tim planinama, jaguar nije samo životinja — to je simbol. 'To je prekrasna stvorenje,' kaže on. 'Moja unuka možda nikada neće vidjeti jednog ako nastavimo graditi zidove. Volio bih darovati par teleća da pomognem njegovom preživljavanju.' Biolog McCain se slaže: 'Jaguar pripada ovdje. Pripada Americi baš kao i bjelokljuni orao — i jednako je dragocjen.'

article_content: In the farmlands southwest of Buenos Aires, the ghost town of Epecuen — submerged under saltwater for 25 years — is rising from the depths once again. Once a thriving lakeside resort, Epecuen welcomed 20,000 tourists each season, drawn by its uniquely saline lake, ten times saltier than seawater. With 280 businesses — including hotels, guesthouses, and spas — it was a popular getaway, especially for Buenos Aires’ large Jewish community, who likened its buoyant waters to Israel’s Dead Sea. On November 10, 1985, after years of unusually heavy rainfall, the lake breached its clay dam. Water surged through a retaining wall, flooding streets and homes within days. Residents fled with only what they could carry. Within weeks, nearly 10 meters (33 feet) of corrosive saltwater buried the entire town. Among those displaced was Norma Berg, who recalls her pets vanishing days before the flood. 'I think they knew the water was coming,' she said. For decades, Epecuen lay silent beneath the waves. But since 2009, water levels have steadily dropped, revealing a haunting landscape: rusted cars, collapsed homes, toppled gravestones, and broken appliances half-buried in a silvery crust of salt. Today, it draws intrepid tourists — many traveling six hours over 550 kilometers of rural roads — to walk among the ruins, climb staircases leading nowhere, and photograph the skeletal remains of a vanished community. Only one person remains: 81-year-old Pablo Novak. He lives on the town’s edge, rides his bicycle through the wreckage, and welcomes visitors with quiet pride. 'Whoever passes nearby cannot go without visiting,' he says. 'I’m alone, but I’m OK. I read the paper. And I always remember the town’s golden days.' Nearby Carhue has capitalized on the region’s legacy, building new spas and resorts to attract tourists seeking the same healing waters. 'We now have both the ruins and new opportunities,' says Javier Andrés, local tourism director. Epecuen’s eerie beauty even inspired the 2010 horror film 'And Soon The Darkness,' starring Karl Urban. Local legend claims the lake was formed by the tears of a chief mourning his lost love — a poetic echo of the town’s own sorrow.

Jednom je bio živahni jezerski kurort koji je svake sezone dobio 20.000 turista, privlačen svojim jedinstveno solenim jezerom, deset puta solenijim od morske vode. S 280 poslova — uključujući hotele, gostionice i spa centre — bio je popularan odmor za veliku židovsku zajednicu iz Buenos Airesa, koja je njegovu plivajuću vodu uspoređivala s Mrtvim morem u Izraelu. 10. studenog 1985., nakon godina neočekivano jakih kiša, jezero je prešlo svoju glinenu branu. Voda je provalila kroz zid i potopila ulice i kuće unutar dana. Stanovnici su pobježali s onim što su mogli. U roku od tjedan dana, gotovo 10 metara (33 stope) korozivne slane vode potopilo je cijeli grad. Među one iseljenike bila je i Norma Berg, koja se sjeća kako joj su se ljubimci izgubili danima prije poplave. 'Mislim da su znali da dolazi voda,' rekla je. Dugo godina Epecuen je ležao tiho pod valovima. Ali otkad 2009. razina vode stalno opada, otkriva se užasavajući pejzaž: oštećeni automobili, srušene kuće, prevrnuti nadgrobnici i slomljena kućna oprema polupokrivena srebrno-bijelom koricom soli. Danas ga posjećuju odvažni turisti — mnogi putuju šest sati preko 550 kilometara uskih poljskih cesta — kako bi šetali ruševinama, penjali se na stepenice koje nikuda ne vode i fotografirali kosture nestalog mjesta. Samo jedna osoba ostaje: 81-godišnji Pablo Novak. Živi na rubu grada, vozi bicikl kroz ruševine i pozdravlja posjetitelje s tihom ponosnošću. 'Tko god prođe pored, ne može otići bez da posjeti ovdje,' kaže on. 'Sam sam, ali mi je u redu. Čitam novine. I uvijek se sjećam zlatnih dana grada.' Bliski Carhue iskoristio je naslijeđe regije, gradeći nove spa centra i kurorte kako bi privukao turiste koji traže iste liječne vode. 'Imamo i ruševine i nove prilike,' kaže Javier Andrés, direktor lokalnog turizma. Epecuenova užasavajuća lijepota inspirirala je i horor film 'I uskoro tamnina' iz 2010. s Karлом Urbanom. Mjesni legendi kažu da je jezero nastalo suzama češća koji je žalio za svojom omiljenom — poezija koja odražava tužbu samog grada.

article_content: Beyoncé and Jay-Z kicked off their long-awaited joint 'On The Run Tour' on Wednesday night at SunLife Stadium in Miami, Florida — delivering a performance that blended spectacle with intimate vulnerability. In a rare public moment, the famously private duo shared never-before-seen footage of their 2008 wedding, including scenes of them exchanging matching ring tattoos and Jay-Z slipping a ring onto Beyoncé’s finger. Clips of their daughter, Blue Ivy, further underscored the theme of family. This heartfelt display stood in stark contrast to the controversial May 2014 elevator incident involving Jay-Z and Beyoncé’s sister, Solange Knowles. Since then, the family has publicly stated they’ve reconciled and moved forward as one. The concert, devoid of any opening act, centered entirely on the Carters — Billboard described it as a powerful journey through fashion, performance, and music, all anchored by the enduring message of love, tested but unbroken. According to Consequence of Sound, the show featured a 42-song setlist spanning over two hours. One fan summed up the experience on Twitter: 'BRILLIANT. Started with “this is not real life” (stories) & ended with “this is real life” (family videos). EPIC. #OnTheRun #OnTheRunTour.' Forbes journalist Jesse Lawrence noted the tour is on track to become the second-highest-grossing tour of all time per show — behind only U2’s '360 Tour.' If it reaches $100 million in gross revenue, as projected by Ticketmaster, it would average roughly $5 million per show. The North American leg of the tour includes 20 stadium dates.

article_content: After weeks of rain and gray skies, much of the United Kingdom finally welcomed a true summer day on June 4, 2013. Temperatures climbed to 23°C in places like Woodvale near Blackpool, while Glasgow recorded a warm 22°C — a rare treat for Scots tired of spring showers. Crowds flooded into parks and beaches: families picnicked in Hyde Park, students lounged on Barry Beach in South Wales, and locals in Kelvingrove Park sipped ice cream under clear blue skies. The countryside sparkled with golden fields of blooming oilseed rape and buttercups, transforming rural areas into vibrant yellow tapestries. From Stirling Castle to the quiet lanes of South Staffordshire, the landscape seemed painted by sunlight. According to the Met Office, the day’s weather pattern showed more of an east-to-west variation than north-to-south. Eastern England started with patchy clouds and light drizzle along the North Sea coast, but sunshine quickly spread nationwide. While a few isolated showers lingered over northern Scotland, Northern Ireland, and parts of northern England, most of the country enjoyed dry, warm conditions. Forecasts hinted at even hotter days ahead — London was expected to hit 24°C by Friday. Meanwhile, everyday moments became celebrations: a four-year-old dashed through fountains in London’s Peace Gardens, a woman pedaled a Boris bike while licking an ice lolly, and an olive baboon at Knowsley Safari Park coolly enjoyed its own frozen treat. It wasn’t just weather — it felt like a collective sigh of relief, a national pause to soak in the warmth before the next raincloud rolled in.

Gomile su se okupile u parkovima i na plažama: obitelji su imale piknik u Hyde Parku, studenti su se opuštali na Barry Beachu u Južnom Velsu, a lokalni stanovnici u Kelvingrove Parku pili su sladoled pod jasnim plavim nebom. Zemlja je sjala zlatnim poljima cvjetajućeg uljanog repa i žutih ružica, pretvarajući ruralne područja u žive žute tapiserije. Od Stirling Castlea do tihih cesta južnog Staffordshira, pejzaž je izgledao kao da ga je naslikalo sunce. Prema Met Officeu, uzorak vremena tog dana pokazivao je više isto-zapadnu razliku nego sjevero-jugovitnu. Istočna Engleska je počela s odsječnim oblacima i laganim kišicama duž obale Sjevernog mora, ali sunce se brzo proširilo cijelim zemljom. Iako su se nekoliko izoliranih oluja zadržale nad sjevernom Škotskom, Sjevernom Irskom i dijelovima sjeverne Engleske, većina zemlje uživala je u suhom i toplom vremenu. Prognoze su namještale još toplije dane — očekivalo se da će London doseći 24 °C u petak. U međuvremenu, svaki dan je postajao proslava: četverogodišnja djevojčica je trčala kroz fontane u Londonovim Peace Gardensima, žena je vozila bicikl Boris i ljula sladoled, a olivna babun na Knowsley Safari Parku hladila se svojim vlastitim smrznutim ukusom. Nije bilo samo vrijeme — osjećalo se kao zajednički uzdah olakšanja, nacionalni trenutak da se uživa u toplini prije nego što se sljedeća oblačnost pojavila.

article_content: Google has begun alerting users when it suspects they are being targeted by state-sponsored hackers, the tech giant announced. Users who receive the warning see a prominent message at the top of their browser: 'Warning: We believe state-sponsored attackers may be attempting to compromise your account or computer.' Users in China have already started receiving these alerts. One former journalist, Mei — who asked to be identified only by her first name for security reasons — reported seeing the message multiple times. Initially concerned the warning itself might be part of a scam, she reached out to a private Google group of around 200 members to check if others had seen it. About ten members confirmed receiving similar messages, some in Chinese and others in English. Mei, who left journalism and Beijing in 2009, expressed surprise at being targeted, given her distance from high-profile work. 'I didn’t think I’d still be on their radar,' she said. Although Google has not directly accused China of orchestrating the attacks, the company has had longstanding disputes with Beijing over internet censorship and control. Google declined to explain how it identifies state-sponsored activity, citing security concerns. 'We can't go into the details without giving away information that would be helpful to these bad actors,' said Eric Grosse, Google’s Vice President of Security Engineering, in a blog post. Importantly, receiving the warning does not mean an account has been breached — only that Google has detected signs of phishing, malware, or other hacking attempts targeting the user. Google urges recipients to strengthen their passwords, enable two-factor authentication, and keep software up to date.
translated_content: Google je započeo upozoravati korisnike kada sumnja da su cilj državno podržanih hakera, objavila je tehnološka tvrtka. Korisnici koji primaju upozorenje vide istaknutu poruku na vrhu svog preglednika: 'Upozorenje: Vjerujemo da državno podržani napadači pokušavaju kompromitirati vaš račun ili računalo.' Korisnici u Kini već su počeli primati ova upozorenja. Jedna bivša novinarka, Mei — koja je zatražila da se identificira samo po imenu iz sigurnosnih razloga — prijavila je da je više puta vidjela tu poruku. Na početku je bila zabrinuta da bi samо upozorenje moglo biti dio prevara, pa se obratila privatnoj Google grupi od oko 200 članova kako bi provjerila jesu li drugi također primili poruku. Otprilike deset članova potvrdilo je da su dobili slične poruke, neke na kineskom, a neke na engleskom jeziku. Mei, koja je napustila novinarstvo i Peking 2009. godine, izrazila je iznenađenje zbog ciljanja, uzimajući u obzir da više nije u središtu pažnje. 'Nisam mislila da sam još uvijek na njihovom popisu', rekla je. Iako Google nije direktno optužio Kinu za organiziranje napada, tvrtka je imala dugotrajne neslaganja s Pekingom oko cenzure i kontrole interneta. Google je odbio objasniti kako identificira državno podržane aktivnosti, navodeći sigurnosne razloge. 'Ne možemo ulaziti u detalje bez otkrivanja informacija koje bi bile korisne tim lošim akterima', rekao je Eric Grosse, voditelj sigurnosnog inženjeringa Googlea, u blog postu. Važno je napomenuti da primanje upozorenja ne znači da je račun kompromitiran — samo da je Google otkrio znakove phishinga, malvare ili drugih napadačkih pokušaja usmjerenih prema korisniku. Google preporučuje korisnicima da jačaju lozinke, omoguće dvofaktorsku autentikaciju i održavaju softver ažuriranim.

article_content: In a move that avoids jail time, rapper Kanye West and his business manager, Don Crawley, have been given a chance to wipe the slate clean—by completing 50 hours of community service before December 23. The agreement follows a 2008 incident at Los Angeles International Airport, where the two men became involved in a heated exchange with photographers, resulting in the destruction of a camera. Though initially charged with vandalism, battery, and grand theft—offenses that could have landed West in prison for up to two and a half years and Crawley for five—the court opted for restorative measures instead. West’s attorney confirmed he’s already finished 12 hours of court-ordered anger management and paid to replace the damaged equipment. Judge Mark Zuckman acknowledged the moment was likely fueled by impulse rather than malice, noting that such reactions, while wrong, don’t automatically signify deep-seated criminal behavior. But he was clear: damaging someone’s property—even under provocation—isn’t acceptable. 'There are other ways to respond,' Zuckman stressed. Had anyone been physically hurt, he said, the outcome would have been far more serious. With the community service requirement met, all charges will be dropped.

Sporazum je uslijedio nakon incidenta iz 2008. godine na Međunarodnom zračnom luci Los Angelesa, gdje su dvojica muškaraca ušla u oštar sukob s fotografima, što je dovelo do uništenja kamere. Iako su prvotno optuženi za štetu, napad i veliku krađu – kazne koje bi mogle dovesti Westa u zatvor do dvije i pol godine, a Crawleyja do pet godina – sud se odlučio za obnovne mjere. Westov odvjetnik potvrdio je da je već završio 12 sati zakonski propisanih časova upravljanja ljutnjom i nadoknadio štetu na opremi. Sudac Mark Zuckman priznao je da je trenutak vjerojatno bio rezultat impulsa, a ne zloće, primjećujući da takve reakcije, iako pogrešne, ne znače automatski duboko ukorijenjeno kriminalno ponašanje. Ali bio je jasan: oštećivanje tuđe imovine – čak i pod provokacijom – nije prihvatljivo. 'Postoje drugi načini da se odgovori,' naglasio je Zuckman. Da je netko bio fizički povrijeđen, rekao je, ishod bi bio znatno ozbiljniji. S obzirom na ispunjenje zahtjeva za zajedničkim radom, sve optužbe biti će odbačene.

article_content: Archie Brooks, 21, admitted to common assault after a glass he threw struck his colleague Olivia Parish in the face during a post-work drink at a London bar. The incident occurred on March 30, 2012, following an alcohol-inclusive team meeting. Brooks and Parish, both employees of London-based Coal IT, had been exchanging heated words when Brooks hurled the contents of his tumbler — including the glass — at her. He later claimed he only intended to embarrass her by splashing her with drink, not to cause injury. Parish sustained a laceration to her lip requiring stitches and was dismissed from her position. Brooks was also fired from his £32,000-per-year role, which included performance bonuses of up to £8,000 per transaction. Initially charged with assault occasioning actual bodily harm, Brooks pleaded guilty to the lesser offense of common assault before a jury was seated. At the hearing, Judge Stephen Kramer QC condemned Brooks’ behavior as 'drunken and loutish,' noting that such actions in central London typically result in imprisonment. However, due to Brooks’ age, lack of prior convictions, and early guilty plea, he received a £1,000 fine, £250 in compensation to Parish, and £100 toward court costs. Brooks, who resides in Redbridge, east London, is now pursuing a career in fashion, having launched his own clothing brand.
translated_content: Archie Brooks, 21, priznao je krivnju za uobičajeno prekršajno djelo nakon što je bacio čašu koja je pogodila njegovu kolegicu Oliviju Parish u lice tijekom poslijeposlovnog pića u londonskom baru. Incidencija se dogodila 30. ožujka 2012., nakon sastanka koji je uključivao alkohol. Brooks i Parish, oba zaposlenika londonske tvrtke Coal IT, razmijenile su napete riječi kada je Brooks bacio sadržaj svoje tumbler čaše — uključujući i samu čašu — na nju. Kasnije je tvrdio da je samo htio ponižiti nju bacanjem pića, a ne da joj nanese ozljedu. Parish je dobila reze na usnama koje su zahtijevale šavove i otpuštena je s posla. Brooks je također otpušten sa svog godišnjeg plaćanja od 32.000 funti, koje je uključivalo performansne bonus od do 8.000 funti po transakciji. Iako mu je izvorno bila postavljena optužba za napad uz stvarnu tjelesnu štetu, Brooks je priznao krivnju za manje teško prekršajno djelo — uobičajeni napad — prije nego što je izabrana žirija. Na suđenju, sudac Stephen Kramer QC osudio je Brooksovo ponašanje kao 'pijano i grubo', napominjući da takvo ponašanje u središtu Londona obično rezultira zatvorskom kaznom. Međutim, zbog Brooksove mladosti, nedostatka prethodnih kazni i ranog priznanja krivnje, dobio je kaznu od 1.000 funti, 250 funti naknade Parish i 100 funti za troškove suđenja. Brooks, koji živi u Redbridgeu, istočni London, sada se bavi modom i pokrenuo je vlastitu odjećnu marku.

article_content: In a case that has drawn public attention to professionalism in law enforcement, 26-year-old police officer Saheena Tegally is facing charges of perverting the course of justice after allegedly mishandling a traffic stop involving a Porsche driver. The incident unfolded in July 2013 in Highgate, North London, when Tegally and two colleagues pulled over Richard Myerson, a 25-year-old man driving an uninsured Porsche 911 Turbo. Reports suggest that following the stop, the two exchanged a series of casual, flirtatious text messages—some of which included playful remarks about her uniform and even a photo of Myerson dressed in a 1940s style. Tegally later told the court these messages were simply 'banter,' not signs of favoritism. She admitted she failed to notice that Myerson’s insurance had expired months earlier, mistakenly believing the documents were valid. Prosecutors argue that Tegally concealed this critical detail, encouraged a fellow officer to destroy handwritten notes documenting the violation, and misled colleagues into thinking Myerson was insured. Tegally, who has been suspended since the investigation began, insists she never intended to interfere with justice. Speaking emotionally in court, she described her police work as her life’s calling and denied any deliberate wrongdoing. She acknowledged the exchanges were unprofessional but maintained they never led to any actual cover-up. Myerson, meanwhile, reportedly joked about meeting up to 'hunt pickpockets' together—a comment Tegally later shared with friends, even boasting she’d 'seized a Porsche off a 25-year-old who’s minted.' The trial continues, with the jury now weighing whether their interactions crossed the line from awkward flirtation to misconduct.

Incident se dogodio u srpnju 2013. godine u Highgateu, sjeverni London, kada su Tegally i dva kolege zaustavili Richarda Myersona, 25-godišnjeg muškarca koji je vozio neosiguranu Porš 911 Turbo. Prema izvještajima, nakon kontrole, dvojica su razmjenjivala niz neformalnih, flirtnih tekstualnih poruka – neke od njih uključivale su igraličke komentare o njezinoj uniformi te čak i fotografiju Myersona u odijelu iz 1940-ih. Tegally je kasnije rekla sudu da su ove poruke jednostavno 'šala', a ne znakovi pristranosti. Priznala je da nije primjetila da je Myersonovo osiguranje isteklo mjesecima ranije i pogrešno je vjerovala da su dokumenti važeći. Tužitelji tvrde da je Tegally sakrila ovaj ključni detalj, poticala kolegu da uništi ručno napisane bilješke koje su dokumentirale prekršaj i zavarala kolege da misle da je Myerson bio osiguran. Tegally, koja je oduzeta od dužnosti od početka istraživanja, tvrdi da nikad nije namjeravala ometati pravosuđe. Govoreći emotivno pred sudom, opisala je svoj rad kao policajku kao svoj životni poziv i odbila bilo kakvu namjernu kršenja. Priznala je da su razmjene bile neprofesionalne, ali je održala da one nikad nisu dovele do stvarnog sakrivanja dokaza. Myerson je, između ostalog, izgleda šaljivo predložio da zajedno 'love krađe iz džepova' – komentar koji je Tegally kasnije podijelila s prijateljima, čak i pohvalivši se da je 'uhvatila Porša kod 25-godišnjaka koji je minted'. Suđenje se nastavlja, a žiriju je sada na zadatku da utvrdi jesu li njihove razmjene prešle granicu između neugodnog flirtovanja i zloupotrebe dužnosti.

article_content: A legendary British landmark once used to film classic horror movies is now on the market. Oakley Court, a grand gothic-style mansion built in 1859 near Windsor, served as the eerie backdrop for Hammer Horror’s Dracula and Frank N Furter’s castle in The Rocky Horror Picture Show. After decades as a film set following its last private owner’s death in 1965, the estate was transformed into a hotel in 1981 and welcomed guests—including Team GB athletes during the 2012 London Olympics. Now, following the hotel’s entry into administration last week, the entire property is up for sale. It includes 118 bedrooms—among them 11 luxurious suites—multiple conference spaces, and a private nine-hole golf course spread across more than 37 acres of meticulously maintained gardens that border a secluded stretch of the River Thames. Though the asking price remains undisclosed, industry experts say the combination of its cinematic legacy, prime location, and extensive facilities make it one of the most compelling hospitality assets to appear on the market in recent memory. Administrators KPMG reported a £7.3 million net turnover for the year ending December 31, 2012. Julian Troup of Colliers International, handling the sale, expects strong domestic and international interest, noting the property’s unique blend of history, charm, and scale.

Oakley Court, velika gotska vila izgrađena 1859. godine blizu Windsora, poslužila je kao mračna pozadina za Drakulu od Hammer Horrora i zamak Franka N. Furtera u Rocky Horror Picture Showu. Nakon decenija korištenja kao filmske lokacije nakon smrti posljednjeg privatnog vlasnika 1965. godine, imovina je pretvorena u hotel 1981. godine i primila goste — uključujući atlete iz tima GB tijekom Olimpijskih igara u Londonu 2012. godine. Sada, nakon što je hotel stupio u upravljanje prošlog tjedna, cijela imovina je na prodaju. Uključuje 118 spavaćih soba — među njima 11 luksuznih apartmana — više konferencijskih prostora i privatni devetotručni golf igralište rasprostranjeno preko više od 37 akara pažljivo održavanih vrta koji se protežu uz zatvoreni dio rijeke Temze. Iako je tražena cijena još uvijek nepoznata, stručnjaci smatraju da kombinacija njegove filmske baštine, izvrsne lokacije i obimnih pogodnosti čini ovaj objekt jednim od najzanimljivijih hotela koji su se pojavili na tržištu u posljednjih godina. Administratori KPMG prijavili su neto promet od 7,3 milijuna funti za godišnji period koji je završio 31. prosinca 2012. godine. Julian Troup iz Colliers International, koji upravlja prodajom, očekuje jak interes i domaćih i stranih kupaca, naglašavajući jedinstvenu kombinaciju povijesti, šarm i razmjera ove imovine.
