article_content: The body of Private Matthew Thornton, a 28-year-old soldier in the Territorial Army, was found 30 feet up in a tree after his patrol was lured into a hidden bomb, an inquest has heard. Thornton, who was five weeks into his deployment in Helmand, Afghanistan, was killed instantly when he stepped on a pressure-activated improvised explosive device (IED). In civilian life, he worked as a factory worker in Barnsley and was described by his captain, Stephen Dando, as 'a cracking soldier who gave 100 per cent.' On November 9, 2010, Thornton and members of the First Battalion, The Yorkshire Regiment, were patrolling north of Checkpoint Loy Mandeh in Lashkar Gah when they came under fire from Taliban insurgents. Soldiers took cover behind a wall as grenades and small arms fire erupted. Moments later, a massive explosion occurred — triggered by an IED concealed in the undergrowth beneath them. The blast was so powerful that Thornton’s body was thrown approximately 30 feet into a nearby tree. Major Stephen Sutherland, a bomb disposal expert at the scene, said the device was unusually large — far bigger than typical IEDs used previously — suggesting insurgents were now deploying more lethal weapons to guarantee fatalities. He added that the grenade attacks may have been deliberately used to drive soldiers into the kill zone. Pathologist Dr. Russell Delaney concluded that Thornton’s injuries were immediately fatal and that he likely felt no pain. Deputy Coroner Donald Coutts-Wood recorded a verdict of unlawful killing, calling Thornton 'a clearly courageous and very special young man.' In a statement following the inquest, Thornton’s family said he was 'proud to be part of the Yorkshire Regiment' and believed deeply in the mission — including efforts to build bridges and schools in local communities. His parents, brother, and sister emphasized that he was dedicated to serving his country and felt his work was making a difference.

Privatni Thornton, koji je bio pet tjedana u svojoj službi u Helmandu, Afganistan, ubijen je odmah kada je stupio na pritisak aktivirani improvizirani eksplozivni uređaj (IED). U građanskom životu radio je kao radnik u tvornici u Barnsleyju i opisan je od strane svog kapetana, Stephena Danda, kao 'odličan vojnik koji je dao 100 posto.' 9. studenoga 2010. godine, Thornton i članovi Prve bojne, Yorkshire Regimenta, bili su u patruli sjeverno od kontrolne točke Loy Mandeh u Lashkar Gahu kada su bili napadnuti od strane talibanskih pobunjenika. Vojni su se sakrili iza zida dok su granate i puščani metci palili. Nekoliko trenutaka kasnije dogodila se ogromna eksplozija – uzrokovana IED-om skrivenim u biljaštu ispod njih. Eksplozija je bila toliko snažna da je tijelo Thorntona baceno otprilike 9 metara u blisku stablo. Major Stephen Sutherland, stručnjak za razbijanje bombe na mjestu događaja, rekao je da je uređaj bio neobično velik – daleko veći od tipičnih IED-a koji su se ranije koristili – što sugerira da su pobunjenici sada koristili smrtonosnije oružje kako bi osigurali smrt. Dodao je da su napadi granatama možda namjerno korišteni da bi potjerali vojnike u zonu smrti. Patolog Dr. Russell Delaney zaključio je da su Thorntonove ozljede bile odmah smrtonosne i da vjerojatno nije osjetio bol. Zamjenik sudac Donald Coutts-Wood zabilježio je zaključak o nezakonitom ubojstvu, nazvavši Thorntona 'jasno hrabrim i vrlo posebnim mladim muškarcem.' U izjavi nakon istrage, Thorntonova obitelj rekla je da je bio 'ponosan što je dio Yorkshire Regimenta' i duboko vjerovao u misiju – uključujući napore za gradnju mostova i škola u lokalnim zajednicama. Njegovi roditelji, brat i sestra naglasili su da je bio posvećen službi svojoj zemlji i osjećao je da njegov rad čini razliku.

article_content: In a quiet corner of Trabuco Canyon, California, a beloved holiday tradition is facing an unexpected challenge. For at least five years, around 15 to 20 residents have united each December to decorate their neighborhood with a dazzling array of interconnected Christmas lights strung between homes—creating a glowing canopy over the street. Now, Orange County officials have sent notices ordering homeowners to remove the displays by mid-December, citing safety concerns. According to Jean Pasco of the Orange County Council, the issue isn't the lights on private property, but those suspended over public roads—potentially dangling too low and posing risks during storms, including electrocution hazards. Residents, however, are baffled. Many say they were never informed such displays violated any code, and the notices provided no specific ordinance number. Brian Kopiec, a local homeowner, recalled being told by previous owners that the area was famous for its festive spirit. 'All the poor kids love it,' he told KTLA. 'It brings us together.' While officials stress public safety, many residents feel the move undermines community joy—and some worry it signals excessive enforcement. With Christmas just weeks away, the lights remain up—for now—as residents consider whether to comply.

Sada su službenici Okruga Orange poslali obavijesti stanovnicima da uklone te prikaze do sredine prosinca, navodeći brige o sigurnosti. Prema Jean Pasco iz Vijeća okruga Orange, problem nije u svjetlima na privatnoj imovini, već u onima preko javnih cesta—koje mogu visiti prenisko i predstavljati opasnost tijekom oluja, uključujući rizik od električnog udara. Stanovnici su međutim zbunjena. Mnogi kažu da im nikada nije rečeno da takvi prikazi krše neki zakon, a obavijesti nisu naveli ni jedan konkretni broj zakonske odredbe. Brian Kopiec, lokalni vlasnik kuće, sjeća se kako su mu prethodni vlasnici rekli da je ova četvrt poznata po svom blagdanskom duhu. 'Sva sirota djeca to vole,' rekao je KTLA. 'Povezuje nas.' Iako službenici naglašavaju javnu sigurnost, mnogi stanovnici osjećaju da ova akcija podkopava duh zajednice—neki se boje da to označava prekomjernu primjenu pravila. S božićom na vrhuncu, svjetla ostaju uključena—za sada—dok stanovnici razmišljaju hoće li se pridržavati naredbe.

article_content: Goodwood officials anticipate their summer Festival will ascend to the global racing stage following the announcement of the largest sponsorship deal in British horse racing history. A 10-year partnership with Qatar Racing and Equestrian Club — also the backer of Longchamp’s Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe — will boost the 2015 five-day event’s total prize money to £4.5 million, with £2 million specifically directed toward eight key races. The prestigious Group One Sussex Stakes — previously won by champions Kingman and the legendary Frankel — will receive an additional £700,000, elevating its value to £1 million and making it only the sixth such race in Britain to reach that milestone. The Group One Nassau Stakes has been raised to £600,000, while each featured Group Two race — the Lennox Stakes, Goodwood Cup, and King George Stakes — will now offer £300,000 in prize money. The historic Stewards’ Cup, whose name was controversially dropped during last season’s sponsorship by bookmaker 32Red — a move later labeled a 'mistake' by course owner Lord March — will be reinstated with a £250,000 purse. Although the event will now be officially branded the Qatar Goodwood Festival, Managing Director Adam Waterworth confirmed that the beloved unofficial title 'Glorious Goodwood' will remain in common use by the overwhelming majority of fans. The festival begins on July 28. This deal underscores the growing reliance of British racing on Qatari investment, with Qipco already supporting the British Champions Series and Champions Day at Ascot in October. Waterworth, aiming to attract more international entries, stated: 'I’ve always believed the Festival week at the end of July on the Sussex Downs is one of the most special weeks of the year. This partnership elevates the meeting — especially to those outside the sport. The prize money now stands alongside the best in the world.' Separately, champion jump jockey AP McCoy will present the trophy to the winner of the William Hill PDC World Darts Championship at Alexandra Palace on January 4.

Desetogodišnje partnerstvo s Katarom za trčanje i konjesticu — također pokrovitelj Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe na Longchampu — povećat će ukupnu nagradnu fondu petodnevne manifestacije 2015. godine na 4,5 milijuna funti, pri čemu će 2 milijuna funti biti usmjereno na osam ključnih trka. Prestižna trka Group One Sussex Stakes — koju su ranije osvojili šampioni Kingman i legendarni Frankel — dobit će dodatnih 700.000 funti, čime će njena vrijednost porasti na 1 milijun funti, čineći je šestom takvom trkom u Britaniji koja dostiže taj iznos. Trka Group One Nassau Stakes povećana je na 600.000 funti, dok će svaka od ključnih trka Group Two — Lennox Stakes, Goodwood Cup i King George Stakes — sada nositi nagradu od 300.000 funti. Povijesna Stewards’ Cup, čije je ime kontroverzno uklonjeno tijekom prošlogodišnjeg sponsorstva kladionice 32Red — korak koji je vlasnik staze Lord March kasnije nazvao 'pogreškom' — biti će vraćena s nagradom od 250.000 funti. Iako će se događaj sada službeno zvati Qatar Goodwood Festival, generalni direktor Adam Waterworth potvrdio je da se omiljeni neoficijalni naziv 'Glorious Goodwood' i dalje koristi od strane većine obožavatelja. Festival počinje 28. srpnja. Ovo partnerstvo ističe rastuću ovisnost britanskog trčanja o katarskim ulaganjima, s time da je Qipco već podržavao britansku seriju prvenstava i Champions Day na Ascotu u listopadu. Waterworth, koji želi privući više međunarodnih natjecatelja, rekao je: 'Uvijek sam mislio da je tjedan festivala na kraju srpnja na brdima Sussexa jedan od najspecijalnijih tjedana godine. Ovo partnerstvo podiže događaj — posebno za one izvan trčanja. Nagradne fondove sada možete usporediti s najboljima na svijetu.' Zasebno, prvak skokova AP McCoy predat će trofej pobjedniku William Hill PDC Svjetskog darts prvenstva na Alexandra Palaceu 4. siječnja.

article_content: By Margot Peppers. PUBLISHED: 11:45 EST, 11 November 2013. | UPDATED: 15:26 EST, 11 November 2013. A former employee of AshleyMadison.com — a dating website for married individuals seeking affairs — is suing the company for $21 million. According to the Canadian Star, Doriana Silva claims that shortly after being hired in March 2011, she was instructed to create 1,000 fake female profiles within three weeks to attract male users. This intense workload led to severe wrist pain. Silva says she was never informed of the ethical and legal implications of this task and believed it was standard industry practice. When she requested ergonomic support for her injuries, her appeals were ignored. She now alleges she is seriously disabled and unable to work since 2011. Silva is seeking $20 million for unjust enrichment and an additional $1 million in punitive and general damages. AshleyMadison.com’s spokesperson told MailOnline that Silva’s allegations are 'without merit,' pointing to recent photographs of her jet skiing and posing cheerfully in front of a city skyline as evidence she has not suffered serious injury. 'Our service is 100% authentic, as described in our terms and conditions,' the spokesperson said. 'We resent any implication otherwise and are confident we will be both vindicated and victorious in court.' Silva’s lawyer, Paul Dollak, argues the case invokes the legal doctrine of 'waiver of tort' — meaning the company profited directly from the harm she endured while performing her duties. The website’s terms state: 'You acknowledge and agree that any profiles of users and members, as well as communications from such persons, may not be true, accurate, or authentic and may be exaggerated or fantasy. You acknowledge and understand that you may be communicating with such persons and that we are not responsible for such communications.'

Kad je zatražila ergonomsku podršku za svoje ozljede, njezini su zahtjevi ignorirani. Sada tvrdi da je ozbiljno invalidna i ne može raditi otkako je 2011. godine. article_content: After more than 14 years on the run, Antonio Iovine — a feared figure in Italy’s Camorra underworld — has been captured in southern Italy. The arrest, carried out by police in Naples, marks a significant milestone in the nation’s ongoing battle against organized crime. Iovine, 46, was one of the country’s top 30 most-wanted fugitives and had been living underground since being sentenced to life in prison in 2008 for his involvement in mafia activities. Authorities believe he remained in control of his clan’s financial operations while evading capture, functioning as its secretive 'boss manager.' Interior Minister Roberto Maroni described the arrest as a turning point in efforts to dismantle Camorra networks across Campania, calling it 'a beautiful day for the fight against the mafia.'

Vlasti vjeruju da je ostao u kontroli financijskih operacija svoje klane dok je bijegao, funkcionirajući kao njen tajni 'šef menadžer'. article_content: In a surprise overnight trip, President Barack Obama arrived at Bagram Air Base in Afghanistan under the cover of night, delivering a powerful message of support to nearly 2,000 U.S. service members stationed there. Speaking directly to the troops, he acknowledged the difficulty of their mission but stressed that their work remains critical to protecting American families. 'If I didn’t believe this was vital to our national security,' he said, 'I’d bring you home immediately.' Obama highlighted measurable gains against al Qaeda and its affiliates, asserting that sustained pressure is necessary to keep terrorist groups off balance. He underscored that America doesn’t walk away from its commitments — 'We persevere,' he told the soldiers, 'and together, we will prevail.' Before heading to the airbase, Obama held a private 30-minute meeting with Afghan President Hamid Karzai, where both leaders discussed progress in building Afghan-led security and governance. Karzai expressed deep gratitude for U.S. financial and logistical support in rebuilding Afghanistan. The visit also included briefings with U.S. Ambassador Karl Eikenberry and General Stanley McChrystal, commander of NATO forces in the region. The entire journey — beginning at Camp David and ending with a pre-dawn return to Andrews Air Force Base — was conducted in strict secrecy. Obama’s unannounced visit aimed not only to boost morale among the 80,000 American personnel in Afghanistan but also to signal to both allies and adversaries that the U.S. remains fully engaged in the long-term effort to stabilize the region.

Govoreći direktno vojnicima, priznao je težinu njihove misije, ali naglasio da njihov rad ostaje ključan za zaštitu američkih obitelji. 'Ako ne bih vjerovao da je ovo vitalno za našu nacionalnu sigurnost,' rekao je, 'odmah bih vas vratio kući.' Obama je istaknuo izmjerive napretke protiv Al-Kaide i njenih saveznika, tvrdeći da je održavanje pritiska nužno kako bi se terorističke grupe držale na udaru. Prije nego što je krenuo na bazu, Obama je održao privatni 30-minutni sastanak s afganskim predsjednikom Hamidom Karzaijem, tijekom kojeg su oba vođe raspravljala o napretku u izgradnji afganske sigurnosti i uprave. Karzai je izrazio duboku zahvalnost za američku financijsku i logističku podršku u obnovi Afganistana. Posjeta je uključivala i kratke savjetovanja s američkim ambasadorom Karlom Eikenberryjem i generalom Stanleyem McChrystalom, zapovjednikom snaga NATO-a u regiji. Cijelo putovanje — koje je počelo u Camp Davidu i završilo ranim jutrom povratkom na vojnu bazu Andrews — provedeno je u strogoj tajnosti. Obamajevo nenajavljeno posjetanje imalo je za cilj ne samo podići moral od 80.000 američkih vojnika u Afganistanu, već i poslati signal saveznicima i protivnicima da SAD ostaju potpuno angažirani u dugoročnom traganju za stabilizacijom regije.

article_content: Passengers on Southwest Airlines can now read e-books or play Candy Crush during taxiing, takeoff, and landing — thanks to new FAA guidelines permitting the use of portable electronic devices in airplane mode throughout all flight phases. Southwest announced its adoption of the policy on Wednesday, joining a wave of U.S. carriers that have swiftly updated their rules since the FAA relaxed restrictions three weeks ago. JetBlue Airways and Delta Air Lines were among the first to implement the change on November 1, followed by American Airlines on November 4, United Airlines on November 6, and US Airways on November 7. Other airlines are moving to catch up: Virgin America aims to roll out the policy this month, ideally in time for the holiday travel season. 'We're in the process of applying through the new process and hope to implement the changes as soon as possible,' said Virgin America spokesperson Abby Lunardini. Spirit Airlines confirmed it is coordinating with the FAA but has not yet set a firm implementation date. 'I don't have a specific implementation date at this time,' said spokeswoman Misty Pinson. Despite the broadened allowances, key restrictions remain. Devices must be in airplane mode or have cellular service disabled. Making or receiving phone calls is still prohibited once the main cabin door is closed until a crew member announces that calls are permitted upon landing. Passengers must also power down devices during safety briefings. Additionally, any electronic device weighing more than two pounds — such as laptops — must be stowed in an overhead bin or beneath the seat during takeoff and landing. Importantly, these updated rules apply only to mainline domestic flights; regional partners like US Airways Express must obtain separate FAA approval. The policy shift has sparked both relief and amusement. Earlier this month, Twitter user @RealMediaMedusa joked that the new rules came 'too late for Alec Baldwin,' referencing his 2011 removal from a flight for refusing to turn off his device at the gate.
translated_content: Putnici na Southwest Airlines sada mogu čitati e-knjige ili igrati Candy Crush tijekom klizanja, uzlijetanja i slijetanja — zbog novih smjernica FAA koje dopuštaju korištenje prijenosnih elektroničkih uređaja u zrakoplovnom načinu rada tijekom svih faza leta. Southwest je objavio primjenu ove politike srijedom, pridružujući se valu američkih zračnih prijevoznika koji su brzo ažurirali svoja pravila nakon što je FAA opustila ograničenja prije tri tjedna. JetBlue Airways i Delta Air Lines bile su među prvim koji su uveli promjenu 1. studenoga, slijedio je American Airlines 4. studenoga, United Airlines 6. studenoga, a US Airways 7. studenoga. Ostali prijevoznici pokušavaju stići: Virgin America cilja uvesti politiku ovaj mjesec, idealno u vrijeme blagdana. 'U procesu smo prijave prema novom postupku i nadamo se da ćemo promjene uvesti što je prije moguće,' rekla je predstavnica Virgin America Abby Lunardini. Spirit Airlines potvrdila je da koordinira s FAA-om, ali još nema određeni datum implementacije. 'Trenutno nemam specifičan datum implementacije,' rekla je predstavnica Misty Pinson. Unatoč širem dopuštanju, ostaju ključna ograničenja. Uređaji moraju biti u zrakoplovnom načinu rada ili im mora biti onemogućen servis mobilne mreže. Pravljenje ili primanje poziva i dalje je zabranjeno od trenutka zatvaranja vrata glavnog kabine do trenutka kad član posade obavi objavu da su pozivi dopušteni pri slijetanju. Putnici također moraju isključiti svoje uređaje tijekom sigurnosnih uputa. Dodatno, bilo koji elektronički uređaj težak više od dvije funte — kao što su laptopovi — mora biti smješten u spremnik iznad ili ispod sjedala tijekom uzlijetanja i slijetanja. Važno je napomenuti da ova pravila vrijede samo za domaće letove glavnih linija; regionalni partneri poput US Airways Express moraju dobiti zasebno FAA odobrenje. Ova promjena politike izazvala je i olakšanje i šaljivost. Rano ovog mjeseca, Twitter korisnik @RealMediaMedusa nasmijao se da su nova pravila došla 'prekasno za Aleca Baldwina', referirajući se na njegov incident iz 2011. godine kada ga je odbacio let jer je odbio isključiti svoj uređaj na vrati.

article_content: On Monday afternoon, police responded to reports of two vehicles lingering near the entrance of ANSTO, Australia’s premier nuclear research facility located in Lucas Heights, south of Sydney. Officers from both the New South Wales Police and the Australian Federal Police arrived at the scene and engaged with five men who were in the vehicles. After conducting brief interviews, authorities confirmed all individuals were cleared and permitted to leave without charge. One report from Nine News noted that two of the men were seen praying while awaiting questioning — a moment that humanized an otherwise tense situation. The vehicles, including a dark-colored 4WD, were checked but found to pose no threat. No security breach occurred, and normal operations at ANSTO resumed shortly after.

Policajci iz New South Wales Police i Australijske savezne policije stigli su na mjesto događaja i razgovarali s pet muškaraca koji su bili u vozilima. Nakon kratkih intervjua, vlasti su potvrdile da su svi pojedinci oslobođeni i dopušteni da odu bez optužbi. Jedan izvještaj iz Nine Newsa napomenuo je da su dva muškarca vidjena kako se mole dok su čekala ispitivanje — trenutak koji je humanizirao inače napetu situaciju. Vozila, uključujući tamnoplavo 4WD, provjerena su i utvrđeno da ne predstavljaju prijetnju. Nije došlo do prekršaja sigurnosti, a normalne operacije na ANSTO-u obnovljene su nakon kratkog vremena.

article_content: By Damien Gayle. PUBLISHED: 00:54 EST, 11 November 2013. | UPDATED: 09:22 EST, 11 November 2013. Bulmers’ blunder: This advertisement featured Hugh Price-Hughes, a lifelong teetotaller and Methodist clergyman who campaigned vigorously against alcohol. Executives at the Hereford-based cider maker Bulmers have admitted they made a serious error by using the image of a teetotal Victorian vicar—someone who dedicated his life to helping alcoholics—in a promotional campaign for their alcoholic beverage. The company believed the photograph depicted Reverend C.H. Bulmer, the patriarch who provided the initial funding to launch the business 120 years ago. Next to the black-and-white image was the slogan: 'We hope he’d be proud.' Had he known how the image was being used, Hugh Price-Hughes would almost certainly not have been proud. The man in the photo was indeed Hugh Price-Hughes, born in Carmarthen in 1847. He served as a Methodist minister across multiple circuits, founded new churches, established the Methodist Times, and launched the Wesleyan Forward Movement—which oversaw the construction of many major urban Methodist missions still standing today. The mistake was uncovered after Heineken, which owns Bulmers, invested tens of thousands of pounds in the campaign. Once alerted by the Advertising Standards Authority (ASA), the company immediately withdrew all related advertisements and posters. This incident follows the ASA’s recent dismissal of a separate complaint about a different Bulmers TV ad. One viewer argued the commercial implied that the success of a social gathering depended on alcohol. That ad depicted a night out in reverse: friends were shown drinking Bulmers throughout the evening, starting with the first drink. A voiceover stated: 'We don’t have a master plan, so we don’t know where the night will take us. But one thing is certain—it will begin with a Bulmers.' The ASA responded: 'While we acknowledged the characters clearly intended to consume alcohol, we noted the product appeared only briefly and no irresponsible drinking behavior was depicted. We concluded the ad did not imply alcohol was essential to social success and therefore did not breach the Code.' A Bulmers spokesperson said: 'We fully appreciate the distress caused by using the wrong image.' In response, Heineken has pledged a donation to the church in Carmarthen, West Wales, where Reverend Price-Hughes served as minister in the 1870s.

Upravnici herefordskog proizvođača sidra Bulmers priznali su da su napravili ozbiljnu pogrešku koristeći sliku teetotallera viktorijanskih vremena — čovjeka koji je posvetio život pomoći alkoholičarima — u promocijskoj kampanji za svoj alkoholni proizvod. Tvrtka je mislila da je fotografija prikazuje svećenika C.H. Bulmera, osnivača koji je pružio početna sredstva za pokretanje posla prije 120 godina. Pored crno-bijele slike bio je slogan: 'Nadamo se da bi bio ponosan.' Da je znao kako se njegova slika koristi, Hugh Price-Hughes bi gotovo sigurno ne bio ponosan. Muškarac na slici bio je zapravo Hugh Price-Hughes, rođen u Carmarthenu 1847. godine. Služio je kao metodistički svećenik u raznim krugovima, osnovao nove crkve, osnovao 'Methodist Times' i pokrenuo 'Wesleyan Forward Movement' — organizaciju koja je nadzirala izgradnju mnogih velikih gradske metodističke misije koje i danas stoje. Pogreška je otkrivena nakon što je Heineken, vlasnik Bulmersa, uložio desetke tisuća funti u kampanju. Kada je obaviještena od strane Uprave za standardizaciju reklama (ASA), tvrtka je odmah povukla sve povezane reklame i plakate. Ovaj incident slijedi nedavno odbacivanje od strane ASA druge pritužbe o drugoj TV reklami Bulmersa. Jedan gledatelj je tvrdio da reklama sugerira da je uspjeh društvene priče uvijek ovisio o alkoholu. Ta reklama prikazivala je noć u obrnutom redoslijedu: prijatelji su prikazani kako piju Bulmers tokom cijele večeri, počevši od prvog pića. Glas na pozadini kaže: 'Nemamo glavni plan, pa ne znamo gdje će nas noć odvesti. Ali jedna stvar je sigurna — počinje s Bulmersom.' ASA je odgovorila: 'Iako smo prepoznali da su likovi u reklami namjeravali piti alkohol, primijetili smo da je proizvod prikazan samo na nekoliko prilika i da likovi nisu ponašali kao da su neodgovorno pili. Zaključili smo da reklama ne sugerira da je uspjeh društvenih prilika ovisan o konzumaciji alkohola i stoga ne prekrši Propis.' Predstavnik Bulmersa rekao je: 'Potpuno shvaćamo uzbuđenje uzrokovano korištenjem pogrešne slike.' U odgovoru, Heineken je obećao donaciju crkvi u Carmarthenu, Zapadni Wales, gdje je svećenik Price-Hughes služio u 1870-ima.

article_content: The Delhi High Court has given the Indian government one final window—eight weeks—to finally establish clear rules for selling medicines online. The court pointed out that this issue has been pending for more than five years, during which time the central authorities have repeatedly delayed action despite multiple court reminders. The case stems from petitions filed since 2018, including one by Dr. Zaheer Ahmed, who argued that unrestricted online drug sales endanger public health by enabling self-medication, sales without prescriptions, and distribution of controlled substances like psychotropics. Another petition, brought by the South Chemists and Distributors Association, claims these digital pharmacies are breaking the law by operating outside the framework of long-standing regulations such as the Drugs and Cosmetics Act and the Pharmacy Act. The court heard arguments from the government’s legal team, who claimed discussions were still underway about a draft rule issued back in August 2018. But the judges were unmoved, stating that five years is more than enough time to finalize such critical public health guidelines. To ensure accountability, the court warned that if no policy is submitted within the deadline, the Joint Secretary responsible for pharmaceutical regulation must appear in person at the next hearing on March 4, 2024. The court also reaffirmed its earlier 2018 order banning online medicine sales, noting that no legal provision currently permits such activity. Petitioners argue that the unchecked growth of e-pharmacies undermines fair competition by allowing them to sidestep licensing, storage, and dispensing rules that physical pharmacies must follow. They further contend this creates unequal conditions violating citizens’ fundamental rights under Articles 14, 19, and 21 of the Constitution. Despite a web of laws—including the Pharmacy Practice Regulations (2015), the Code of Ethics (2002), and the Objectionable Advertisements Act (1954)—online sellers reportedly operate without oversight, raising serious questions about enforcement and public safety.

Predmet proizlazi iz zahtjeva podnesenih od 2018. godine, uključujući jedan od dr. Zaheera Ahmeda, koji je tvrdio da neograničena prodaja lijekova online ugrožava javno zdravlje omogućujući samoliječenje, prodaju bez recepta i distribuciju kontroliiranih tvari poput psihoaktivnih supstanci. Još jedan zahtjev, podnio Savez južnih ljekarnika i distributera, tvrdi da ove digitalne ljekarne krše zakon jer rade izvan okvira dugotrajnih propisa kao što su Zakon o lijekovima i kozmetici i Zakon o farmaciji. Sud je čuo argumente pravnika vlade koji su tvrdili da su rasprave još u tijeku o nacrtu pravila objavljenog još u kolovozu 2018. godine. Ali su sudci bili neosjetljivi, navodeći da je pet godina više nego dovoljno vremena za završetak takvih kritičnih smjernica za javno zdravlje. Da bi osigurali odgovornost, sud je upozorio da ako se politika ne predaste unutar roka, Savjetnik za zdravstvene poslove mora osobno prisustvovati sljedećoj sjednici 4. ožujka 2024. godine. Sud je također potvrdio svoj raniji nalog iz 2018. godine koji zabranjuje prodaju lijekova online, napominjući da trenutno ne postoji zakonska odredba koja to dopušta. Zahtjevoci tvrde da nekontrolirani rast e-ljekarni podkopava pravednu konkurenciju jer im omogućuje da zaobiđu licenciranje, skladištenje i propise o isporuci koje fizičke ljekarne moraju slijediti. Dalje tvrde da ovo stvara nejednake uvjete koji krše temeljna prava građana prema članovima 14, 19 i 21 Ustava Indije. Unatoč mreži zakona – uključujući Propise o praksi farmacije (2015.), Propise o etici (2002.) i Zakon o zabranjenim reklamama (1954.) – online prodavači se, kako se tvrdi, ne drže nikakvih pravila, što podiže ozbiljna pitanja o primjeni i javnom zdravlju.

article_content: Edward Putman, 47, was convicted in 1993 of raping a 17-year-old girl and sentenced to seven years in prison, serving four. After his release, he won £4.5 million in the National Lottery in September 2009. He attempted to keep his win secret by falsely claiming £15,000 monthly in income support and housing benefits — a deception uncovered when he tried to buy his former council flat with £83,000 in cash. In 2012, he admitted to two counts of benefit fraud and was jailed for nine months. Now released, Putman has submitted planning applications to demolish his £600,000 home in Kings Langley, Hertfordshire, and replace it with a 30-bedroom budget hotel adjacent to the M25. The proposal, initially rejected by Three Rivers Council, includes two floors of rooms, a dining area, kitchen, and office. A property developer, FJ Thompson, has been hired to refine the plans. Local residents and crime prevention advisors have voiced strong opposition. One officer warned the proposed underground car park could attract antisocial behavior and serve as a shelter for youths in bad weather. Many describe Putman as unfit to operate a hospitality business, citing his violent history. Putman’s criminal record extends beyond rape: he was convicted of wounding with intent in the 1980s after stabbing a neighbor, and of witness intimidation and perverting the course of justice. His ex-partner, Gail Vincent, revealed he threatened her with a knife, abused their children’s pets, pushed her down the stairs while she was eight months pregnant, and failed to pay child support. She later withdrew a 1998 rape allegation under pressure from his associates and was jailed for perverting justice herself. His daughter from another relationship accused him of sexual abuse, threats with a kitchen knife, and alcohol-fueled violence. She described him as a 'Jekyll and Hyde' character — charming publicly, monstrous privately. Despite public outcry, Lib Dem councillor Joy Mann supports the project, arguing it would create jobs and boost local commerce in an industrial zone. article_content: Sam Altman will not return as CEO of OpenAI, according to The Information, which cited a statement from board director Ilya Sutskever to staff. Instead, Emmett Shear — co-founder of Twitch and former head of the Amazon-owned platform — has been named interim CEO. OpenAI has not yet responded to a Reuters request for comment. Despite efforts by OpenAI executives to bring Altman back, Sutskever confirmed he will not resume the role. The report offered no further details, and Reuters could not independently verify the claim. On Sunday, Altman and former OpenAI president Greg Brockman appeared at the company’s San Francisco headquarters, following an invitation from interim CEO Mira Murati. Altman is reportedly exploring a return to OpenAI, including discussions on improving governance, while also considering launching a new AI startup. OpenAI’s board fired Altman on Friday — a move that sent shockwaves through the tech world, as he was widely seen as the public face of generative AI. In response, Altman posted a photo on X showing himself wearing an OpenAI guest badge with the caption: 'first and last time i ever wear one of these.' The dismissal sparked anger among current and former employees and raised concerns about the stability of OpenAI’s upcoming $86 billion fundraising round. Brockman, who previously stepped down as board chair and resigned from the company, also showed up at the office on Sunday. According to The Information, citing two sources familiar with the matter, Microsoft — OpenAI’s largest investor — is considering joining the board, either as a full voting member or as a non-voting observer.

Iako su izvršni direktori OpenAIja pokušali vratiti Altmana, Sutskever je potvrdio da on neće ponovo preuzeti ulogu. Izvještaj nije pružio dodatne detalje, a Reuters nije mogao neovisno potvrditi tu tvrdnju. Nedjelju je Altman i bivši predsjednik OpenAIja Greg Brockman pojavili na sjedištu tvrtke u San Franciscu, nakon poziva privremenog CEO-a Miri Murati. Altman je prema izvještajima razmatrao povratak u OpenAI, uključujući rasprave o poboljšanju upravljanja, dok istovremeno razmišlja o pokretanju novog AI startupa. Ploča OpenAIja otpustila je Altmana petka — korak koji je izazvao šok u tehnološkom svijetu, jer je on bio široko priznat kao lice generativne AI. U odgovoru je Altman objavio fotografiju na X-u koja prikazuje njega u gostujućoj kartici OpenAIja s napomenom: 'prvi i posljednji put kad ću nositi jednu od ovih.' Otpuštanje je izazvalo bijes među trenutnim i bivšim zaposlenicima te zabrinutost zbog stabilnosti nadolazeće financijske akcije od 86 milijardi dolara. Brockman, koji je ranije ostavio položaj predsjednika ploče i napustio tvrtku, također se pojavio na poslovnom prostoru nedjelju. Prema The Informationu, citirajući dva izvora upoznata s razgovorima, Microsoft — najveći investitor OpenAIja — razmatra ulazak na ploču, bilo kao punopravni član ili promatrač bez prava glasa.

article_content: On New Year’s Eve 2013, London-based artist Clinton De Menezes, 43, was shot and killed while protecting his family during a home invasion at his first wedding anniversary celebration in Durban, South Africa. Four armed intruders breached the balcony of a friend’s home in Westville, where De Menezes, his wife Nicola Saward, their seven-year-old daughter Eva, and friends Simon and Amanda Malpas were gathered. As the attackers stormed the house, De Menezes hid his wife and daughter in a bathroom and a laundry basket, respectively, and attempted to fend off the assailants. His best man, Simon Malpas, fought back with a chair. De Menezes was fatally wounded. As he lay dying, Nicola kissed him and closed his eyes, thanking him for being a devoted husband and father. Eva, hidden safely, also bid her father farewell. The intruders fled with a wallet and three mobile phones. Police later arrested four suspects and recovered a 9mm pistol at the scene. Born in South Africa and based in London since 2007, De Menezes had recently moved to Nairobi to be with his family. He was a prolific artist whose work—spanning painting, installation, drawing, and photography—had been exhibited worldwide, including at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York. Antonio Capelao, owner of London’s Bicha Gallery and a longtime collaborator, described De Menezes as 'absolutely devoted to his family,' recalling how he chose relocation over career advancement: 'My family is going, and my place is with my family.' Capelao noted that De Menezes’ career was flourishing—he had works displayed alongside renowned artists like Anish Kapoor—and called him 'an inspiring artist and a man of integrity.' Our thoughts are with Nicola, Eva, and all who loved him.

De Menezes je smrtno ranjen. Dok je ležao umirući, Nicola ga je poljubila i zatvorila mu oči, zahvaljujući mu što je bio posvećeni muž i otac. article_content: A new analysis reveals that five top schools send as many pupils to Oxford and Cambridge as 1,800 state schools combined. A small group of elite institutions is tightening its grip on the UK’s most prestigious universities, as wealthy families invest increasing sums in education. In 2011/12, three private schools and two elite sixth-form colleges sent 260 students to Oxbridge—the same number as 1,800 state schools across England. Pembroke College at Oxford University admitted students from five of the country’s top schools. Similar findings from the prior three years showed the top five schools and colleges produced as many Oxbridge acceptances as roughly 1,500 state schools. The Sutton Trust, which commissioned the research, warned of a widening gap between Britain’s wealthiest families and middle-income households. Affluent families are allocating more resources to education, recognizing its growing role in securing top jobs and positions of power. The five leading schools for Oxbridge admissions include Eton—David Cameron’s alma mater—Westminster, where Nick Clegg studied, and St Paul’s, which educated George Osborne. The remaining two are state sixth-form colleges: Hills Road in Cambridge and Peter Symonds in Winchester—both popular choices among professional parents seeking to maximize their children’s chances of Oxbridge admission. The analysis, conducted by the Sutton Trust, also shows that just 40 schools and colleges accounted for about a quarter of all Oxbridge entrants in 2011/12. These institutions are a mix of elite private schools and high-performing state grammar schools and sixth-form colleges. The only state comprehensive on the list is Cherwell School in Oxford. In a blog post, Lee Elliot Major, the Trust’s Director of Development and Policy, called the figures 'powerful,' highlighting how a tiny fraction of the UK’s 2,750 schools dominate enrollment at elite universities. He described this as a 'sombre message' for the hundreds of thousands of students awaiting their A-level results in August. Despite universities’ efforts, entry to top institutions is increasingly dominated by children from privileged backgrounds. 'The concern is that a small cadre of schools is tightening its grip on elite university places,' he said. 'The figures suggest students from the wealthiest families are pulling further ahead in the race for prestigious degrees—and the powerful careers they enable.' 'This yawning gap affects not only the poorest children but also those from 'normal' middle-income homes.' Mr. Elliot Major added: 'The social mobility arms race is escalating as the richest families invest more to ensure their children excel at school and university—they recognize education’s critical role in determining workplace success.' The data comes from the latest available figures released by the Department for Education. Despite billions spent over the past 15 years on outreach programs, bursaries, and funding to widen access, the proportion of A-level students from comprehensives entering the UK’s 30 most academically selective universities dropped from 23% in 2008/09 to 19% in 2011/12. Mr. Elliot Major warned that prominent roles in politics, law, media, and the civil service—where an Oxbridge degree remains a key gateway—will continue to be dominated by graduates from narrow socioeconomic backgrounds. However, he also noted exceptional comprehensives, such as Mossbourne Community Academy, which was founded by Sir Michael Wilshaw—now head of Ofsted—and sent 7% of its 2011/12 cohort to Oxbridge. 'We know tens of thousands more academically talented students across the country could thrive at university—even Oxbridge—if given the right support,' Mr. Elliot Major concluded.

Mr. Elliot Major upozorio je da će značajne pozicije u politici, pravu, medijima i građanskoj službi — gdje Oxbridge diplomu još uvijek smatraju 'propusnicom za uspjeh' — nastaviti dominirati diplomantima iz uskih socijalnih krugova. Popis uključuje Mossbourne Community Academy, koju je izgradio Sir Michael Wilshaw, sada na čelu Ofsteda, i koja je 2011./12. poslala 7% svog učeništva na Oxbridge. article_content: For six grueling days, 40 construction workers have been trapped deep beneath the rubble of a collapsed tunnel in India’s mountainous Uttarakhand region. Rescue teams are racing against time, using a powerful new American Auger drill to carve a narrow escape route through tons of rock and debris. So far, they’ve cleared 24 meters — but need another 36 to reach the men. The drill, capable of cutting through five meters of earth per hour and equipped with a 990-millimeter-wide pipe, has faced setbacks: fractured rocks damaged its bearings, forcing a temporary halt. Repairs are underway, and a second heavy-duty machine is en route, expected to arrive Saturday. Meanwhile, the trapped workers aren’t alone. Every two hours, care packages — packed with nuts, roasted chickpeas, popcorn, and essential medicines — are pushed down a slender pipe to sustain them. Though some reported mild fever and body aches, their overall condition hasn’t worsened. The tunnel, part of the high-profile Chardham highway meant to connect sacred Hindu pilgrimage sites, collapsed after a landslide on Sunday. The region, known for its unstable terrain and heavy tourist traffic, has seen rapid infrastructure development in recent years. With around 200 rescue workers on site using drills and excavators, officials have reached out to global specialists — including the Thai team that rescued the 2018 cave-bound soccer team and Norway’s Geotechnical Institute — to bring every possible resource to bear.

Alat, sposoban da probije pet metara zemlje po satu i opremljen cijevi promjera 990 milimetara, suočio se s teškoćama: pucanje stijena oštetilo je ležajeve, što je prisilo na privremenu pauzu. Popravci su u tijeku, a drugi teški stroj je u putu i očekuje se da će stići subotu. U međuvremenu, zarobljeni radnici nisu sami. Iako su neki izvijestili o blagim groznica i bolovima u tijelu, njihovo ukupno stanje se nije pogoršalo. Tunel, dio visokoprofilne autoceste Chardham koja povezuje sveta hinduistička mjesta hodočašća, kolapsirao je nakon klizanja stijena u nedjelju. article_content: Lee Dong-wook recently sat down for an interview at a cozy café in Samcheong-dong, Seoul, to discuss his latest film, 'Single in Seoul.' The actor warmly recommended the movie to fans, suggesting it could add a spark to relationships—and for those going through breakups, it might evoke memories of happier times. 'Single in Seoul' centers on the romance between Yeong-ho (played by Lee Dong-wook), a contented loner who cherishes his solitude, and Hyun-jin (played by Lim Soo-jung), an editor crafting a book about single life. Lee Dong-wook expressed hope for the film’s success, highlighting its relatable themes and timely message. He praised Lim Soo-jung’s warm personality off-camera and her meticulous, inspiring approach to acting, which helped create a comfortable set environment. He also commended the director for being open-minded and receptive to actor input. Lee Dong-wook found the film’s ending realistic and fitting, and noted the romance genre’s universal appeal—easy and comforting for viewers of all ages. Interestingly, he admitted to sharing traits with his character, confessing that, like Yeong-ho, he prefers single life. He openly shared his perspectives on dating and marriage during the conversation. article_content: The saga of Anthony Weiner’s mayoral campaign has come to a close, as his wife declined to accompany him to the primary polls this morning — adding what many saw as a final public insult. Weiner claimed his wife, Huma Abedin, was occupied with a work call and unable to join him at the polling station. Given her long-standing role as a senior aide to Hillary Clinton and her presence in Washington, D.C., the night before the election attending a fundraiser, her absence was not entirely unexpected. Instead, the disgraced former congressman cast his ballot with his young son, Jordan, by his side — a moment that may mark the last time his name appears on a ballot. Amid the chaos of a crying toddler and difficulties securing him in his stroller, Weiner faced another obstacle: his name was missing from the local voter registry in New York’s Flatiron neighborhood. Poll workers had to contact the Board of Elections to confirm his signature was on file; the omission was deemed an administrative error. Weiner quipped that it was likely because he was 'not very well known.' This occurred hours after a tense, widely viewed interview with MSNBC’s Lawrence O’Donnell, who bluntly asked, 'What is wrong with you?' O’Donnell suggested Weiner suffered from a psychological compulsion to remain in public office, citing his post-scandal lobbying efforts and persistent political ambitions. Weiner denied the characterization, accusing O’Donnell of cutting him off, yet offered no concrete account of his activities during his hiatus beyond earning income to support his family. Previous reports from The New York Times noted that Weiner and Abedin earned a combined $496,000 in 2012. While O’Donnell avoided directly criticizing Weiner’s past sexting behavior — which Weiner dismissed as 'standard American photography floating online' — he zeroed in on what he described as Weiner’s 'desperate need for elective office' and inability to live outside politics. Weiner countered by attacking O’Donnell’s show and network, accusing them of avoiding substantive issues relevant to New Yorkers. 'What is wrong with me that I care so deeply about the issues I’ve fought for throughout my career?' he demanded. The heated exchange extended beyond the initial eight-minute segment into a follow-up online clip. Earlier that day, Weiner clashed with Today’s Savannah Guthrie, dismissing her questions about Abedin’s reduced campaign role as 'making this a soap opera.' He has repeatedly engaged in confrontations with voters, including a notable incident in Brooklyn where a resident criticized him for marrying 'an Arab' — prompting Weiner to retort, 'jackass.' Meanwhile, the mayoral race has shifted dramatically. Bill de Blasio, former city public advocate, leads with 39% of Democratic support, while Bill Thompson and Christine Quinn trail at 20% each. If no candidate reaches 40%, a runoff will determine the nominee to face the Republican candidate in November. In the comptroller race, former Governor Eliot Spitzer — also tarnished by scandal — is locked in a tight contest with former Manhattan Borough President Scott Stringer. As New York prepares to close the chapter on these turbulent campaigns, the focus remains on whether voters will prioritize redemption, resilience, or rejection.

Weiner je tvrdio da je njegova supruga, Huma Abedin, zauzeta pozivom s posla i nije mogla pratiti ga na glasovnom mjestu. S obzirom na njen dugotrajni položaj kao visokog pomoćnika Hilari Klinton i prisutnost u Vašingtonu, D.C., noć prije izbora na fund-raiseru, njeno odsustvo nije bilo potpuno neočekivano. Umjesto toga, bivši odbornik koji je bio u sramoti glasao je uz svog mladog sina Jordana — trenutak koji može označiti posljednji put da se njegovo ime pojavi na glasovnoj listi. U srednjem haosu plačućeg djeteta i teškoćama da ga smjesti u kolica, Weiner je suočen s još jednim problemom: njegovo ime nije bilo u popisu biranja u Flatiron distriktu u New Yorku. Radnici na glasovnom mjestu morali su kontaktirati Komisiju za izbore kako bi potvrdili da je njegova potpisna uzorka na datoteci; propust je bio proglašen administrativnom greškom. Weiner je šaljivo rekao da je vjerojatno zato što je 'nije vrlo poznat.' To se dogodilo sat vremena nakon napetog, široko gledanog intervjua s Lawrenceom O'Donnellom sa MSNBC-a, koji mu je bez okolišanja postavio pitanje: 'Što je s tobom krivo?' O'Donnell je predložio da Weiner trpi psihološku kompulziju da ostane u javnom životu, navodeći njegove poslijeskandale aktivnosti lobbiranja i trajne političke ambicije. Weiner je poricao tu karakterizaciju, optužujući O'Donnella da ga prekida, ali nije ponudio nikakav konkretni opis svojih aktivnosti tijekom njegovog odsustva osim da je zaradio novac za podršku obitelji. Prethodni izvještaji iz The New York Timesa naveli su da su Weiner i Abedin zarađivali zajednički 496.000 dolara 2012. godine. Dok je O'Donnell izbjegavao direktno kritiziranje Weinerovih prošlih sexting ponašanja — koja je Weiner odbacio kao 'standardnu američku fotografiju koja plutaju po internetu' — usredotočio se na ono što je opisao kao 'desperatnu potrebu za izbornim službama' i neспособnost da živi izvan politike. Weiner je odgovorio napadajući O'Donnellovu emisiju i mrežu, optužujući ih da izbjegavaju bitne teme relevantne za New Yorkčane. 'Što je s tobom krivo što mi je toliko briga za probleme za koje borim cijelo vrijeme moje karijere?' tražio je. Vruća razmjena se nastavila i nakon početnih osam minuta u dodatnom online segmentu. Rano tog dana, Weiner je imao sukob s Savannah Guthrie iz programa Today, odbijajući njene pitanje o smanjenoj ulozi Abedin u kampanji nakon otkrivanja Weinerovog sexting odnosa s Sydney Leathers. 'Znam da imate fascinaciju da ovo pretvorite u sapunsku operu, ali za građane grada New Yorka, mnogi su htjeli da ovo bude o problemima kampanje,' rekao je. On je ponavljano sudjelovao u sukobima s građanima, uključujući zapaženi incident u Brooklynu gdje je jedan stanovnik kritizirao njega što se oženio 'Arabom' — što je potaklo Weineryja da odgovori: 'jebeni đavo.' Međutim, izbori za gradonačelnika su se dramatično promijenili. Bill de Blasio, bivši javni zagovornik grada, vodi s 39% demokratskih glasova, dok ga Bill Thompson i Christine Quinn prate s 20% svaki. Ako nitko ne dostigne 40%, doći će do drugog kruga koji će odrediti kandidata koji će se suočiti s republikancem u studenom. U izborima za kontrolera, bivši guverner Eliot Spitzer — također oštećen skandalom — nalazi se u tesnom sukobu s bivšim predsjednikom općine Manhattan Scott Stringer. Dok se New York priprema zatvoriti poglavlje o ovim turbulentnim kampanjama, fokus ostaje na tome hoće li volitelji prioritetirati ispravku, otpornost ili odbacivanje.

article_content: Cairo (CNN) — Egyptian President Mohamed Morsy expressed support for calls by the Syrian people for President Bashar al-Assad to be held accountable for war crimes, he told CNN in an exclusive interview on Sunday. 'The Syrian people, through their revolution and movement, will — once the bloodshed stops — enter a new stage with an independent parliament and a government of their choosing,' Morsy, Egypt’s first freely elected president, told CNN’s Wolf Blitzer in Cairo. 'Then, they will decide what to do with those who committed crimes against them. It is for the Syrian people to decide.' Al-Assad’s attempt to crush anti-government protests in 2011 escalated into a brutal civil war, with the United Nations estimating more than 60,000 deaths. In his first televised address since June, al-Assad claimed Syria is under 'an external attack' by 'extremists who only understand the language of killing and criminality.' When asked about Syria, Morsy reiterated his longstanding call for al-Assad to step down. Egypt’s 2011 revolution ousted longtime ruler Hosni Mubarak, and Morsy has pledged Egypt’s support for regional and international efforts to replace al-Assad. When questioned whether Assad should face trial at the International Criminal Court, Morsy responded, 'It’s not my desire — it’s the Syrian people’s desire.' 'This is the people’s moment,' Morsy said. 'Just as the Egyptian people demanded change, so too do the Syrian people. We stand with them, and they will prevail — they have the will to win.' Morsy brokered the November ceasefire that ended an eight-day conflict between Israel and Hamas, the Palestinian Islamist group controlling Gaza. He has now invited the leaders of both major Palestinian factions — Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas and Hamas political chief Khaled Meshaal — to meet in Cairo to pursue national unity, a challenge he admitted would be difficult. Hamas controls Gaza, while Abbas’s Fatah party governs the West Bank; the two have a history of violent clashes. The United States, Israel, and the European Union classify Hamas as a terrorist organization due to its past attacks targeting civilians. During the interview, Morsy sought to reassure global audiences and Egyptians alike that he remains committed to democracy, free speech, and protecting religious minorities — including Egypt’s Coptic Christian community. Having studied in the United States, where he earned a doctorate from the University of Southern California, Morsy said he understands American democracy and is dedicated to upholding its principles in Egypt.

'Sirijci, kroz svoju revoluciju i pokret, će — kad prestane krvoproliće — ući u novu fazu s nezavisnim parlamentom i vladom koju biraju sami,' rekao je Morsy, prvi slobodno izabrani predsjednik Egipta, CNN-ovom Wolfu Blitzeru u Kairu. 'Tada će odlučiti što učiniti s onima koji su počinili zločine protiv njih. To je stvar sirijskog naroda.' Pokušaj al-Asada da uguši antivladne proteste 2011. godine eskalirao je u krvavi građanski rat, pri čemu je Ujedinjeni narodi procijenio da je poginulo više od 60.000 ljudi. U svom prvom emitiranom govoru od lipnja, al-Asad je tvrdio da je Sirija pod 'vanjskim napadom' od strane 'ekstremista koji razumiju samo jezik ubijanja i kriminala.' Kada su ga pitali o Siriji, Morsy je ponovio svoj dugotrajan poziv da al-Asad odstupi. Egipatska revolucija 2011. godine svrgnula je dugo vladajućeg vladaru Hosnija Mubaraka, a Morsy je obećao egipatsku podršku regionalnim i međunarodnim naporima da se al-Asad zamijeni. Kad su ga pitali treba li se Asad suditi pred Međunarodnim kaznenim sudom, Morsy je odgovorio: 'To nije moja želja — to je želja sirijskog naroda.' 'Ovo je trenutak naroda,' rekao je Morsy. 'Kako su egipatski narod tražio promjenu, tako i sirijski narod traži promjenu. Mi ih podržavamo, i oni će pobjediti — imaju volju da pobjede.' Morsy je posredovao u primirju u studenom koje je završilo osmodnevni sukob između Izraela i Hamas-a, palestinske islamske skupine koja kontroliše Gazu. Sada je pozvao vođe obje glavne palestinske frakcije — predsjednika Palestinske vlasti Mahmuda Abbas i političkog vođu Hamas-a Khaleda Mešala — da se susretnu u Kairu kako bi postigli nacionalno jedinstvo, zadatak koji je priznao da neće biti lak. Hamas kontroliše Gazu, dok je Abbasova stranka Fatah kontrolira Zapadnu obalu; dvije frakcije imaju povijest nasilnih sukoba. Sjedinjene Države, Izrael i Europska unija klasificiraju Hamas kao terorističku organizaciju zbog njegovih prošlih napada na civilne žrtve. Tijekom intervjuja, Morsy je pokušao uvjeriti globalnu publiku i egipatske građane da ostaje založen demokraciji, slobodi izražavanja i zaštiti religijskih manjina — uključujući egipatsku koptsku kršćansku zajednicu. Budući da je studirao u Sjedinjenim Državama, gdje je stekao doktorat na Sveučilištu Južne Kalifornije, Morsy je rekao da razumije američku demokraciju i da je založen njezinom održavanjem u Egiptu.

article_content: By James Rush. PUBLISHED: 07:12 EST, 10 February 2013. | UPDATED: 11:32 EST, 10 February 2013. The two young girls orphaned after their parents were killed in the French Alps massacre may be adopted by their aunt. Fadwa al-Saffar seeks to become the legal guardian of Zainab al-Hilli, seven, and her sister Zeena, four, whose parents and grandmother were shot dead in their BMW on a trip to Lake Annecy on September 5, 2012. Their father, Saad al-Hilli, 50, their mother, Iqbal, 47, and grandmother, Suhaila al-Allaf, 74, were killed alongside 45-year-old French cyclist Sylvain Mollier. Police investigations are ongoing. A motorcyclist seen by British cyclist Brett Martin leaving the scene shortly after the killings remains the prime suspect. In December, MailOnline reported that relatives of the girls expressed a desire to care for them, but Surrey County Council placed the children in foster care — a decision the family says was made against their wishes. Fadwa al-Saffar, Iqbal’s sister, is now preparing legal proceedings in family court to gain guardianship, according to The Sunday Times. The family is reportedly upset that the girls have been placed with an English foster family, despite their Iraqi heritage. Their great-uncle, Ahmed al-Saffar, said the girls are permitted only one-hour visits with their aunt each time. He believes social services’ actions violate the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child, which obliges states to preserve a child’s identity, including nationality, name, and family ties. 'Social services are depriving the girls of their culture, religion, language, and family environment,' al-Saffar said. The Sunday Times reported that a police officer involved in the case told a family friend that only immediate family members have had contact with the children. According to the officer: 'Until the investigation reaches a satisfactory conclusion, the girls’ safety and anonymity are of paramount importance.' Surrey County Council responded: 'The welfare of these two little girls is our top priority. Everyone recognizes this is an incredibly sensitive case. Our sole focus is ensuring the children are safe and well. Any suggestion otherwise is simply incorrect.'

Naša jedina briga je osigurati da su djeca sigurna i dobro. Bilo kakva druga tvrdnja je jednostavno netočna.'

article_content: Jerusalem, Israel (CNN) — On Sunday, Israeli Deputy Foreign Minister Danny Ayalon strongly criticized a recent statement issued by Catholic bishops from the Middle East, denouncing remarks made by Archbishop Cyril Salim Bustros as 'libel.' The statement emerged from a two-week synod held in Rome, during which bishops called on the international community — particularly the United Nations — to end Israel’s occupation of Palestinian territories and advance a two-state solution. Ayalon condemned the synod’s outcome, accusing it of being hijacked by an anti-Israel majority and likening its rhetoric to 'the best history of Arab propaganda.' He specifically targeted Archbishop Bustros, who declared at the conference’s final press briefing that 'the promise of the land was nullified by Christ' and that 'there is no longer a chosen people.' Ayalon demanded that the Vatican distance itself from Bustros’ comments, asserting they misrepresent the Jewish people and the State of Israel and should not be considered official Vatican policy. 'These outrageous comments should not cast a shadow over the important relationship between the Vatican, the State of Israel, and the Jewish people,' he said. Meanwhile, the Palestinian Authority welcomed the synod’s conclusions. Saeb Erakat, a senior negotiator for President Mahmoud Abbas, stated that biblical claims to a 'promised land' cannot justify Israeli settlement expansion or exclusive sovereignty over Jerusalem. He added that the Vatican’s stance reinforces Palestinian hopes for an independent homeland and pledged future dialogue to strengthen ties. The synod’s final statement, issued under the auspices of Pope Benedict XVI, affirmed the need for an independent and sovereign Palestinian state alongside a secure Israel within internationally recognized borders. It emphasized Jerusalem’s unique status as a holy city for Jews, Christians, and Muslims, calling for its protection and shared access. The Pope first publicly endorsed the two-state solution during a 2009 visit to the region — a position long resisted by then-Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Recent disputes over settlement construction have further stalled peace efforts. Importantly, Archbishop Bustros’ theological assertions do not represent the official teaching of the Catholic Church, and the Vatican has not endorsed his specific interpretation of scripture.

article_content: Gang members who planted a hand grenade near Kenny Dalglish’s home have been sentenced to life in prison, bringing an end to a brutal campaign of violence across northern England. The gang of five, led by Kirk Bradley and Anthony 'Fat Tony' Downes—both 26—was responsible for multiple shootings, a kidnapping in which the victim was shot and abandoned in woodland, and a series of botched assassination attempts. Their weapon of choice was often the hand grenade, used both in personal vendettas and as hired muscle for powerful figures in Liverpool’s criminal underworld. Jailed in absentia: Anthony 'Fat Tony' Downes, 26, was recaptured in Goes, Zeeland, after a dramatic prison van escape, while Kirk Bradley, 26, received a 22-year minimum sentence despite remaining at large. Gary Wilson, 27, was sentenced to a minimum of 16 years; Joseph Farrell, 23, will serve a minimum of 12 years; and Craig Riley, 25, will serve a minimum of 14 years. Downes and Bradley were convicted in absentia after fleeing ahead of their trial. Downes, described by the court as the gang’s 'chief executive' and known in criminal circles as 'Fat Tony,' was arrested in the Netherlands and will be extradited to the UK. At Woolwich Crown Court, both received life sentences with a minimum of 22 years for conspiracy to possess firearms with intent to endanger life and conspiracy to cause damage with intent to endanger life. Three other members pleaded guilty to possessing firearms and causing criminal damage with intent to endanger life. Gary Wilson, of Southport, received a minimum of 16 years; Joseph Farrell, of Branthway Hey, Stockbridge Village, Knowsley, will serve a minimum of 12 years; and Craig Riley, also of Stockbridge Village, will serve a minimum of 14 years. The grenade placed on Mr. Dalglish’s front wall in July 2009 was not intended for him—he was not then manager of Liverpool FC—but for his neighbor, wealthy businessman John Ball, who had already survived two prior shootings. Ball had hired a security guard after attacks in March and June 2009. The grenade was left by one of two men who fled upon police arrival; one was later arrested. Between 2009 and 2010, Bradley and Downes, who called themselves 'blood brothers,' directed operations remotely without directly committing acts of violence. Downes, serving a seven-year sentence for ATM bombings, allegedly ran the gang from prison. When arrested in Goes, Zeeland, Downes was checking into holiday accommodation and was found in possession of a loaded .44 Magnum revolver and two forged passports. The gang also carried out shootings in pubs, sprayed homes with gunfire, and killed a man for ejecting intruders from a party. Between June 2008 and March 2010, only seven hand grenade explosions occurred in the UK—five were in Merseyside. One grenade detonated inside the home of a targeted man, who was asleep upstairs with his partner and two children. He later told police the blast 'blew the place to bits.' 'It was remarkable no one was injured,' said Judge Henriques. Judge Henriques described Wilson as Downes’s 'right-hand man,' citing over 1,000 phone calls between them. 'You were a most important cog in this conspiracy,' he told Wilson. Riley, previously jailed for four years for drug trafficking, played a key role in transporting an Uzi submachine gun. Farrell admitted supplying firearms for two shootings and a home invasion. Referencing the 2007 murder of schoolboy Rhys Jones—killed in crossfire during a Liverpool gang feud—Judge Henriques stated: 'Merseyside has learned the hard way when it comes to stray bullets.'

article_content: By Jonathan O'Callaghan. It cost NASA $2.5 billion (£1.5 billion) to land the Curiosity rover on Mars. But, with tongue firmly in cheek, perhaps they could have fooled us all by sending a rover to the abandoned Wheal Maid mine in Cornwall instead. Photographer Mike Thomas’s incredible images reveal a secluded landscape in the UK that looks as alien as any surface explored by a Mars rover. The 'Martian' landscape of Wheal Maid mine near Carharrack, Cornwall, is captured in stunning detail by Mike Thomas. Thomas had never heard of the mine until a local recommended he visit. What he found left him stunned. 'I was a bit shocked,' Thomas told MailOnline. 'I didn’t expect the colors to be so vivid — it looked incredibly alien. More like a Doctor Who set.' Opened in 1782, the mine primarily extracted copper but also yielded by-products still visible today: black tin, arsenic, pyrite, and zinc ore. These minerals combine to create the site’s extraordinary hues. Mineral-rich runoff has accumulated in a lagoon on-site, producing vivid colors when water levels drop and sediments coat the edges. The site lies within the Cornwall and West Devon Mining Landscape UNESCO World Heritage Site. Plants across the area are coated in mineral deposits — brambles appear metallic purple, and willow trees take on a strange greenish-yellow tint. The effect is most dramatic after rainfall, under strong sunlight. With summer approaching, Thomas expects the colors to become even more intense. While the site is deemed safe for exploration, local authorities advise against consuming soil or drinking water from the lagoon. The Gwennap Parish Council purchased the mine in 2002 for £1 from former owners Carnon Enterprises. An Environment Agency investigation confirmed localized risks from arsenic, but overall environmental impact remains minimal. According to Parish Chairman Kevin Furnish, 'There’s a slight impact on the local stream, but compared to other tin mines downstream, it’s trivial. There’s no measurable impact beyond a few hundred yards.' Signage educates visitors on both the site’s industrial history and safety guidelines. The area is now a public right of way and hosts mountain bike competitions — motorbikes are strictly prohibited. 'It’s beautiful in its own right,' Thomas concludes. 'I wouldn’t swim in the lagoon though — no.'

Ali, s jezikom u šali, možda bi nas mogli prevariti slanjem rovtera na napuštenu rudu Wheal Maid u Kornvallu. Neverovatne fotografije fotografa Mika Tomasа otkrivaju odvojeni krajolik u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu koji izgleda kao strani kao i bilo koja površina istražena od strane rovtera na Crvenoj planeti. 'Marsianski' krajolik ruda Wheal Maid blizu Carharracka, Kornvall, prikazan je u očaravajućim slikama od Mika Tomasа. Tomas nije nikad čuo za rudnik dok mu lokalac nije preporučio da ga posjeti. Ono što je pronašao ostavilo ga je zapanjenim. 'Bio sam malo šokiran,' rekao je Tomas MailOnlineu. 'Ne očekivao sam da će boje biti toliko žive — izgledalo je izuzetno strano. Više poput skupa iz Doctor Who.' Otvoren 1782. godine, rudnik je uglavnom ekstrahirao bakar, ali je također dao proizvode koji su još uvijek vidljivi: crni kositro, arzen, pirit i cinkova ruda. Ovi minerale kombiniraju se kako bi stvorili izvanredne nijanse lokacije. Mineralno bogat otjecanje nagomilalo se u laguni na lokaciji, stvarajući živopisne boje kada padne razina vode i talozi se nalaze na rubovima. Lokacija se nalazi unutar UNESCO-ove svjetske baštine Cornwall i Zapadnog Devonija. Biljke širom područja prekrivene su mineralnim naslagama — trnje izgleda metalno ljubičasto, a vrbe imaju čudnu zelenkastu žutu nijansu. Učinak je najizrazitiji nakon kiše, pod jakim sunčevim zracima. S obzirom da dolazi ljeto, Tomas očekuje da će boje postati još intenzivnije. Iako je lokacija smatrana sigurnom za istraživanje, lokalne vlasti savjetuju protiv konzumiranja tla ili pijaće vode iz lagune. Vijeće općine Gwennap kupilo je rudnik 2002. godine za jednu funtu od prethodnih vlasnika Carnon Enterprises. Istraživanje Agencije za okoliš potvrdilo je lokalne rizike od arzena, ali ukupan utjecaj na okoliš ostaje minimalan. Prema predsjedniku vijeća Kevinu Furnishu, 'Postoji mali utjecaj na lokalni potok, ali u usporedbi s drugim kositrenim rudnicima dalje nizvodno, to je trivialno. Nema mjerenog utjecaja dalje od nekoliko stotina metara.' Oznake obrazuju posjetitelje o industrijskoj povijesti i sigurnosnim smjernicama. Područje je sada javna prava staza i domaćin natjecanja za planinske bicikle — motocikli su strogo zabranjeni. 'To je lijepo po sebi,' zaključuje Tomas. 'Ne bih plivao u laguni, ipak.'

article_content: Germany's Tommy Haas stunned Roger Federer in straight sets to claim the ATP title on the grass courts of Halle on Sunday. Federer, seeking his sixth victory at this prestigious Wimbledon warm-up event, was outplayed by the 34-year-old veteran, who prevailed 7-6(7-5), 6-4 before a cheering home crowd. It marked Haas’ second Halle title — his first having come in 2009 — and his 13th career ATP singles title. The win represents a remarkable resurgence after undergoing hip surgery that kept him off the tour for 14 months. At the start of 2012, Haas was ranked outside the top 200; he now climbs to World No. 51 and enters Wimbledon as a formidable dark horse. 'This has been one of the best weeks of my career,' Haas told the official tournament website. 'But I don’t think I’ll truly grasp what’s happened until tonight. If anyone had told me beforehand I’d beat Roger Federer — arguably the greatest player of all time — I’d have thought they were crazy!' Federer, coming off a semifinal loss to Novak Djokovic at the French Open, held a 3-1 lead in the first set but lost three straight games as Haas broke back. After winning a tight tiebreak, Haas secured a decisive break to go up 5-4 in the second set and served out the match. When Federer sent a return long, Haas raised his arms in triumph after 95 minutes of intense tennis. Federer, now turning his focus to Wimbledon in pursuit of a record-extending seventh title there, offered generous praise: 'Tommy was the better player today. He fully deserves this win.'

article_content: "I will say, this moment is one that I will never, ever forget," recalled Jason Glisson, describing his 2008 discovery of an ancient tomb in La Milpa, Belize. "I was the first person to enter a long-forgotten manmade chamber. It was an incredible feeling—until I turned on my headlamp and saw three enormous spiders." Though it sounds like a scene from an Indiana Jones movie, Glisson was actually conducting legitimate archaeological research—a passion ignited by watching the iconic films as a child. "Obsessed is more like it," he admitted. He could likely recite entire scenes from the movies, the first of which, Raiders of the Lost Ark, premiered 30 years earlier in 2011. While Indiana Jones is a fictional character, he is undeniably the world’s most recognizable archaeologist. "As a teacher, I ask my students: How many of you were inspired by Indiana Jones?" said Fred Hiebert, an archaeology fellow with National Geographic. "Every hand goes up." Hiebert is co-curator of 'Indiana Jones and the Adventure of Archaeology,' an exhibition debuting at the Montreal Science Centre from April 28 through September 19 before touring internationally. The exhibit features over 100 authentic artifacts alongside original movie props, concept art, and tools used by real archaeologists. Among the treasures: a 6,000-year-old pottery shard bearing the earliest known depiction of wine; a clay tablet inscribed with one of the world’s oldest city maps; and video footage of a scholar deciphering an ancient stela script—long silent since the fall of its civilization. For many, Indiana Jones sparked more than admiration—it sparked a career change. Tim Preston of California, once dreaming of a fedora and bullwhip, traded his corporate job for a life excavating Maya ruins in Belize. "I’ve never dodged a rolling boulder," he said, "but I’m living the dream." Jamin Eggert left his engineering studies at UC San Diego to join an excavation in Jordan. Jasmine Prater pursued geoarchaeology in Guatemala. Dr. R. Grant Gilmore, who manages 650+ archaeological sites, says Indy’s relentless energy motivates him—though he jokes, "I try to be better at balancing work and family." Thomas Riddle, a South Carolina educator, built a curriculum around the films and even visited George Lucas’ Skywalker Ranch—where he stood face-to-face with the very golden idol that captivated him as a 12-year-old in 1981. Real archaeology may lack explosions and chase scenes—but as Glisson put it, "It’s still an adventure." And in an age where everything is a click away, Indiana Jones reminds us: some of the greatest discoveries are still buried, waiting to be uncovered.

"Bio sam prva osoba koja je ušla u dugo zaboravljeni umjetnički prostor. To je bio nevjerojatan osjećaj — dok nisam uključio svjetlo na glavi i video tri ogromna pauka." Iako se čini kao scena iz filma Indiana Jonesa, Glisson je zapravo obavljao legitmno arheološko istraživanje — strast koja je nastala kada je kao dijete gledao ikonične filmove. "Oprezno je više rečeno," priznao je. Vjerojatno bi mogao ponoviti cijele scene iz filmova, od kojih je prvi, Rađači izgubljenog kovčega, premijerno prikazan prije 30 godina — 2011. godine. Iako je Indiana Jones fiktivni lik, on je nedvojbeno najpoznatiji arheolog na svijetu. "Kao nastavnik, pitam svoje učenike: Koliko vas je inspiriralo Indiana Jones filmovi?" rekao je Fred Hiebert, arheološki istraživač iz National Geographic-a. "Svaka ruka se podigne." Hiebert je suradnik u organizaciji izložbe 'Indiana Jones i avantura arheologije', koja je debitirala u Montrealskom znanstvenom centru od 28. travnja do 19. rujna, prije nego što je krenula u međunarodni turnej. Izložba uključuje preko 100 autentičnih artefakata uz originalne rekvizite iz filmova, konceptualne crteže i alate koje koriste stvarni arheolozi. Među blagom: 6.000-godišnji komad keramike s najranijim poznatim prikazom vina; glineni pločić s jednom od najstarijih karti grada na svijetu; i snimka znanstvenika koji dešifrira staru stelu — jezik koji više nije govorio stoljećima. Za mnoge, Indiana Jones je izazvao više nego admiračiju — izazvao je promjenu karijere. Tim Preston iz Kalifornije, koji je sanjao o fedori i biču, zamijenio je posao u poslovnom svijetu životom iskopavanja Maya ruina u Belizeu. "Nikad nisam izbjegavao kotrljajući kamen," rekao je, "ali živim san." Jamin Eggert napustio je studij inženjerstva na UC San Diego kako bi se pridružio iskopavanju u Jordanskoj. Jasmine Prater proučavala je geoarheologiju u Gvatemali. Dr. R. Grant Gilmore, koji upravlja više od 650 arheoloških lokacija, kaže da ga Indyjeva neumorna energija motivira — iako šali: "Pokušavam bolje uravnotežiti posao i obitelj." Thomas Riddle, nastavnik iz Južne Karoline, stvorio je nastavni plan temeljen na filmovima i čak je posjetio Skywalker Ranch kod Georgea Lucasa — gdje je stajao licem u lice s tim zlatnim idalom koje ga je fasciniralo kao 12-godišnjak 1981. godine. Stvarna arheologija možda nema eksplozije i trke — ali kao što je Glisson rekao, "To je i dalje avantura." A u dobu kad se sve može pronaći klikom, Indiana Jones podsjeća nas: još uvijek postoji puno otkrića zakopanih, čekajući da budu otkrivena.

article_content: CNN reports that Ana Lilia Trujillo, 44, is charged with murder in the death of Alf Stefan Andersson, a research professor at the University of Houston. According to Houston police, Trujillo allegedly used one of her own stiletto heels as a deadly weapon. Prosecutors say Andersson suffered 10 puncture wounds on his head — some as deep as 1.5 inches — and between 15 and 20 additional punctures on his face, arms, and neck. The official cause of death has not yet been determined by the Harris County Institute of Forensic Sciences. When police arrived at Andersson’s apartment on Sunday, Trujillo, a former massage therapist, answered the door with blood on her clothing and hands. Andersson was found lying in the hallway, face-up, with a stiletto shoe nearby, according to court records cited by KTRK. Trujillo, who had recently moved in with Andersson, told investigators that he grabbed her and a struggle ensued. She has previously stated in interviews that if anyone ever threatened her, she would use her stiletto heel — a detail shared by Jim Carroll, her former motel manager, with KTRK. Trujillo remains in custody with bail set at $100,000. Her attorney has not yet been publicly identified. CNN was unable to reach any relatives of Trujillo. The University of Houston issued a statement expressing sorrow over Andersson’s death, noting he was a full-time research professor at the Center for Nuclear Receptor and Cell Signaling. CNN’s Brian Carberry and Mayra Cuevas contributed to this report.

Prema policijskom izvještaju iz Hjustona, Trujillo je navodno koristila jedan od svojih vlastitih štikli kao smrtonosno oružje. Trujillo ostaje u zarobljeništvu s kaucijom od 100.000 dolara. Njezin odvjetnik još nije javno identificiran. CNN nije mogao odmah dostići nikoga iz njezine obitelji. Sveučilište u Hjustonu objavilo je izjavu u kojoj izražava žalost zbog tragike smrti Anderssona, napominjući da je bio puno vrijeme istraživački profesor na Centru za nuklearne rektore i ćelijsko signaliziranje.
